<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\Account;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Validator;

class AccountController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        $query = Account::with('parent')->orderBy('code');
        
        if ($request->has('type')) {
            $query->where('type', $request->type);
        }
        
        if ($request->has('active')) {
            $query->where('is_active', $request->boolean('active'));
        }
        
        $accounts = $query->get();
        
        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'data' => $accounts,
        ]);
    }

    public function show(Account $account)
    {
        $account->load('parent', 'children');
        
        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'data' => $account,
        ]);
    }

    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $companyId = auth()->user()?->company_id;
        
        $validator = Validator::make($request->all(), [
            'code' => 'required|string|max:20',
            'name' => 'required|string|max:255',
            'type' => 'required|in:asset,liability,equity,revenue,expense',
            'parent_id' => 'nullable|exists:accounts,id',
            'is_active' => 'boolean',
            'description' => 'nullable|string',
        ]);

        if (!$validator->errors()->has('code')) {
            $codeExists = Account::where('code', $request->code)
                ->when($companyId, fn($q) => $q->where('company_id', $companyId))
                ->exists();
            if ($codeExists) {
                $validator->errors()->add('code', 'This account code is already in use for your company.');
            }
        }

        if ($validator->fails()) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'errors' => $validator->errors(),
            ], 422);
        }

        $account = Account::create([
            'code' => $request->code,
            'name' => $request->name,
            'type' => $request->type,
            'parent_id' => $request->parent_id,
            'is_active' => $request->boolean('is_active', true),
            'is_system' => false,
            'description' => $request->description,
        ]);

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'data' => $account,
            'message' => 'Account created successfully',
        ], 201);
    }

    public function update(Request $request, Account $account)
    {
        if ($account->is_system) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Cannot modify system account',
            ], 403);
        }

        $companyId = auth()->user()?->company_id;

        $validator = Validator::make($request->all(), [
            'code' => 'sometimes|string|max:20',
            'name' => 'sometimes|string|max:255',
            'parent_id' => 'nullable|exists:accounts,id',
            'is_active' => 'boolean',
            'description' => 'nullable|string',
        ]);

        if (!$validator->errors()->has('code') && $request->has('code') && $request->code !== $account->code) {
            $codeExists = Account::where('code', $request->code)
                ->where('id', '!=', $account->id)
                ->when($companyId, fn($q) => $q->where('company_id', $companyId))
                ->exists();
            if ($codeExists) {
                $validator->errors()->add('code', 'This account code is already in use for your company.');
            }
        }

        if ($validator->fails()) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'errors' => $validator->errors(),
            ], 422);
        }

        $account->update($request->only(['code', 'name', 'parent_id', 'is_active', 'description']));

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'data' => $account,
            'message' => 'Account updated successfully',
        ]);
    }

    public function destroy(Account $account)
    {
        if ($account->is_system) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Cannot delete system account',
            ], 403);
        }

        if ($account->children()->count() > 0) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Cannot delete account with child accounts',
            ], 422);
        }

        if ($account->debitTransactions()->count() > 0 || $account->creditTransactions()->count() > 0) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Cannot delete account with transactions',
            ], 422);
        }

        $account->delete();

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'message' => 'Account deleted successfully',
        ]);
    }

    public function initializeDefaultAccounts()
    {
        $companyId = auth()->user()?->company_id;
        $defaultAccounts = Account::getDefaultAccounts();
        
        $created = [];
        
        foreach ($defaultAccounts as $accountData) {
            $parentCode = $accountData['parent_code'] ?? null;
            unset($accountData['parent_code']);
            
            $parentId = null;
            if ($parentCode) {
                $parent = Account::where('code', $parentCode)
                    ->when($companyId, fn($q) => $q->where('company_id', $companyId))
                    ->first();
                if ($parent) {
                    $parentId = $parent->id;
                }
            }
            
            $accountData['parent_id'] = $parentId;
            
            $existing = Account::where('code', $accountData['code'])
                ->when($companyId, fn($q) => $q->where('company_id', $companyId))
                ->first();
            if (!$existing) {
                Account::create(array_merge($accountData, ['company_id' => $companyId]));
                $created[] = $accountData['name'];
            }
        }

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'message' => 'Default accounts initialized',
            'created_count' => count($created),
        ]);
    }

    public function options(Request $request)
    {
        $accounts = Account::where('is_active', true)
            ->orderBy('code')
            ->get(['id', 'code', 'name', 'type']);

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'data' => $accounts,
        ]);
    }

    public function getByType(Request $request)
    {
        $type = $request->get('type');
        
        if (!in_array($type, ['asset', 'liability', 'equity', 'revenue', 'expense'])) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Invalid account type',
            ], 400);
        }

        $accounts = Account::where('type', $type)
            ->where('is_active', true)
            ->orderBy('code')
            ->get(['id', 'code', 'name', 'type']);

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'data' => $accounts,
        ]);
    }

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Models\ProductBatch;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\StockEntry;
use App\Models\StockMovement;
use App\Services\CostingEngine;
use App\Services\InventoryFlowService;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Carbon\Carbon;

class BatchController extends Controller
{
    public function __construct(private readonly InventoryFlowService $inventoryFlowService = new InventoryFlowService())
    {
    }

    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        $query = ProductBatch::with('product');
        
        if ($request->product_id) {
            $query->where('product_id', $request->product_id);
        }
        if ($request->product_id) {
            $query->where('product_id', $request->product_id);
        }
        
        if ($request->variant_id) {
            $query->where('variant_id', $request->variant_id);
        }
        
        if ($request->status === 'expired') {
            $query->whereNotNull('expiry_date')
                  ->whereDate('expiry_date', '<', now());
        } elseif ($request->status === 'expiring_soon') {
            $query->whereNotNull('expiry_date')
                  ->whereDate('expiry_date', '>=', now())
                  ->whereDate('expiry_date', '<=', now()->addDays(30));
        } elseif ($request->status === 'active') {
            $query->where(function ($q) {
                $q->whereNull('expiry_date')
                  ->orWhereDate('expiry_date', '>=', now());
            });
        }
        
        if ($request->search) {
            $search = $request->search;
            $query->where(function ($q) use ($search) {
                $q->where('batch_number', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhereHas('product', fn($pq) => $pq->where('name', 'like', "%{$search}%"));
            });
        }
        
        $batches = $query->orderBy('expiry_date', 'asc')->get();
        
        foreach ($batches as $batch) {
            $batch->available_qty = $this->getBatchAvailableQty($batch);
            $batch->is_expired = $batch->expiry_date ? Carbon::parse($batch->expiry_date)->isPast() : false;
            $batch->is_expiring_soon = $batch->is_expiring_soon ?? false;
        }
        
        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'data' => $batches,
        ]);
    }

    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'product_id' => 'required|exists:products,id',
            'variant_id' => 'nullable|exists:product_variants,id',
            'batch_number' => 'required|string|max:50',
            'manufacture_date' => 'nullable|date',
            'expiry_date' => 'nullable|date|after_or_equal:manufacture_date',
            'purchase_price' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0',
        ]);

        $existing = ProductBatch::where('product_id', $validated['product_id'])
            ->where('batch_number', $validated['batch_number'])
            ->first();
            
        if ($existing) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Batch already exists for this product',
            ], 422);
        }

        $batch = ProductBatch::create($validated);
        
        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'message' => 'Batch created successfully',
            'data' => $batch,
        ], 201);
    }

    public function receive(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'product_id' => 'required|exists:products,id',
            'variant_id' => 'nullable|exists:product_variants,id',
            'warehouse_id' => 'nullable|exists:warehouses,id',
            'location_id' => 'nullable|exists:locations,id',
            'batch_number' => 'required|string|max:50',
            'manufacture_date' => 'nullable|date',
            'expiry_date' => 'nullable|date|after_or_equal:manufacture_date',
            'quantity' => 'required|numeric|gt:0',
            'unit_cost' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0',
            'movement_type' => 'nullable|in:opening,purchase',
            'notes' => 'nullable|string',
        ]);

        $product = Product::findOrFail($validated['product_id']);
        $result = $this->inventoryFlowService->receiveBatchStock($product, [
            ...$validated,
            'reference_type' => 'batch_receipt',
        ]);

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'message' => 'Batch stock received successfully',
            'data' => [
                'batch' => $result['batch'],
                'movement' => $result['movement']->load(['product', 'variant', 'warehouse']),
            ],
        ], 201);
    }

    public function show(ProductBatch $batch)
    {
        $batch->load('product');
        $batch->available_qty = $this->getBatchAvailableQty($batch);
        $batch->is_expired = $batch->expiry_date ? Carbon::parse($batch->expiry_date)->isPast() : false;
        
        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'data' => $batch,
        ]);
    }

    public function update(Request $request, ProductBatch $batch)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'batch_number' => 'sometimes|string|max:50',
            'manufacture_date' => 'nullable|date',
            'expiry_date' => 'nullable|date|after_or_equal:manufacture_date',
            'purchase_price' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0',
        ]);

        $batch->update($validated);
        
        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'message' => 'Batch updated successfully',
            'data' => $batch,
        ]);
    }

    public function destroy(ProductBatch $batch)
    {
        $availableQty = $this->getBatchAvailableQty($batch);
        $hasMovements = StockMovement::where('product_id', $batch->product_id)
            ->where('batch_number', $batch->batch_number)
            ->exists();

        if ($hasMovements) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Cannot delete a batch with stock history. Reverse the related stock movement instead.',
            ], 422);
        }
        
        if ($availableQty < $batch->quantity) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Cannot delete batch with consumed stock. Remaining stock: ' . $availableQty,
            ], 422);
        }
        
        $batch->delete();
        
        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'message' => 'Batch deleted successfully',
        ]);
    }
    
    public function getByProduct(Product $product)
    {
        $batches = ProductBatch::where('product_id', $product->id)
            ->orderBy('expiry_date', 'asc')
            ->get();
            
        foreach ($batches as $batch) {
            $batch->available_qty = $this->getBatchAvailableQty($batch);
            $batch->is_expired = $batch->expiry_date ? Carbon::parse($batch->expiry_date)->isPast() : false;
            $batch->is_expiring_soon = $batch->is_expiring_soon ?? false;
            $batch->expiry_warning = $batch->expiry_warning ?? null;
        }
        
        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'data' => $batches,
        ]);
    }
    
    public function getMovements(ProductBatch $batch)
    {
        $movements = StockMovement::where('batch_number', $batch->batch_number)
            ->where('product_id', $batch->product_id)
            ->orderBy('created_at', 'desc')
            ->limit(50)
            ->get();
            
        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'data' => $movements,
        ]);
    }
    
    public function getAvailableForBilling(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'product_id' => 'required|exists:products,id',
            'variant_id' => 'nullable',
            'warehouse_id' => 'nullable',
        ]);
        
        $costingEngine = new CostingEngine();
        $product = Product::find($validated['product_id']);
        
        $batches = $costingEngine->getAvailableBatches(
            $product,
            $validated['warehouse_id'] ?? null,
            $validated['variant_id'] ?? null
        );
        
        foreach ($batches as $batch) {
            $batch->is_expired = $costingEngine->isBatchExpired($batch->expiry_date);
            $batch->is_expiring_soon = $costingEngine->isBatchExpiringSoon($batch->expiry_date, 30);
            $batch->expiry_warning = $costingEngine->getExpiryWarning($batch->expiry_date);
        }
        
        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'data' => $batches,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Auto-allocate batches for billing
     * Supports FIFO (oldest first) and FEFO (nearest expiry first)
     */
    public function autoAllocate(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'product_id' => 'required|exists:products,id',
            'quantity' => 'required|integer|min:1',
            'variant_id' => 'nullable',
            'warehouse_id' => 'nullable',
            'method' => 'nullable|in:fifo,fefo',  // fifo = oldest created, fefo = nearest expiry
        ]);

        $product = Product::find($validated['product_id']);
        $method = $validated['method'] ?? ($product->tracking_type === 'fifo' ? 'fifo' : 'fefo');
        
        $costingEngine = new CostingEngine();
        
        // Get all available batches ordered based on method
        $query = StockEntry::where('stock_entries.product_id', $validated['product_id'])
            ->whereRaw('(original_qty - COALESCE(quantity_consumed, 0)) > 0')
            ->when($validated['variant_id'] ?? null, fn($q) => $q->where('stock_entries.variant_id', $validated['variant_id']))
            ->when($validated['warehouse_id'] ?? null, fn($q) => $q->where('stock_entries.warehouse_id', $validated['warehouse_id']))
            ->selectRaw('batch_number, 
                         SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ("purchase", "return_in", "transfer_in", "adjustment_positive") THEN original_qty - COALESCE(quantity_consumed, 0)
                              WHEN type IN ("sale", "transfer_out", "return_out", "adjustment_negative") THEN 0
                              ELSE 0 END) as available_qty,
                         MIN(expiry_date) as expiry_date,
                         AVG(cost_price) as avg_cost,
                         MIN(created_at) as oldest_entry')
            ->groupBy('batch_number')
            ->having('available_qty', '>', 0);

        if ($method === 'fefo') {
            // FEFO: Nearest expiry first
            $query->orderByRaw("CASE WHEN MIN(expiry_date) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END")
                  ->orderBy('expiry_date', 'asc');
        } else {
            // FIFO: Oldest batch first (by created_at)
            $query->orderBy('oldest_entry', 'asc');
        }

        $batches = $query->get();
        
        // Calculate allocation
        $remainingQty = $validated['quantity'];
        $allocated = [];
        $totalAvailable = $batches->sum('available_qty');

        if ($totalAvailable < $remainingQty) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => "Only {$totalAvailable} units available in stock, but {$remainingQty} requested",
                'data' => [
                    'available' => $totalAvailable,
                    'requested' => $remainingQty,
                    'allocations' => [],
                ],
            ], 422);
        }

        foreach ($batches as $batch) {
            if ($remainingQty <= 0) break;
            
            $takeFromThis = min($remainingQty, $batch->available_qty);
            
            $allocated[] = [
                'batch_number' => $batch->batch_number,
                'quantity' => $takeFromThis,
                'expiry_date' => $batch->expiry_date,
                'cost_price' => $batch->avg_cost,
            ];
            
            $remainingQty -= $takeFromThis;
        }

        $methodLabel = $method === 'fefo' ? 'First Expired First Out' : 'First In First Out';
        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'data' => [
                'allocations' => $allocated,

            ->groupBy('batch_number')
            ->having('available_qty', '>', 0);

                  ->orderBy('expiry_date', 'asc');
        } else {
            // FIFO: Oldest batch first (by created_at)
            $query->orderBy('oldest_entry', 'asc');

            ];
            
            $remainingQty -= $takeFromThis;
        }

        $methodLabel = $method === 'fefo' ? 'First Expired First Out' : 'First In First Out';
        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,

    public function import(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $request->validate([
            'file' => 'required|file|mimes:csv,txt|max:10240',
        ]);

        $file = $request->file('file');
        $handle = fopen($file->getPathname(), 'r');

        $headers = fgetcsv($handle);
        if (!$headers) {
            return response()->json(['message' => 'Invalid CSV file'], 422);
        }

        $headers = array_map('strtolower', array_map('trim', $headers));

        $requiredFields = ['name', 'mobile'];
        foreach ($requiredFields as $field) {
            if (!in_array($field, $headers)) {
                return response()->json(['message' => "Missing required field: {$field}"], 422);
            }
        }

        $results = [
            'created' => 0,
            'updated' => 0,
            'skipped' => 0,
            'errors' => [],
        ];

        $rowNumber = 1;
        while (($row = fgetcsv($handle)) !== false) {
            $rowNumber++;
            $data = array_combine($headers, $row);

            if (empty($data['name']) || empty($data['mobile'])) {
                $results['errors'][] = "Row {$rowNumber}: Name and mobile are required";
                $results['skipped']++;
                continue;
            }

            $validator = Validator::make($data, [
                'name' => 'required|string|max:255',
                'mobile' => 'required|string|max:20',
                'email' => 'nullable|email',
                'gstin' => 'nullable|string|max:20',
                'address' => 'nullable|string',
                'credit_limit' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0',
            ]);

            if ($validator->fails()) {
                $results['errors'][] = "Row {$rowNumber}: " . implode(', ', $validator->errors()->all());
                $results['skipped']++;
                continue;
            }

            $existingCustomer = Customer::where('mobile', $data['mobile'])->first();

            if ($existingCustomer) {
                $existingCustomer->update([
                    'name' => $data['name'],
                    'email' => $data['email'] ?? $existingCustomer->email,
                    'address' => $data['address'] ?? $existingCustomer->address,
                    'gstin' => $data['gstin'] ?? $existingCustomer->gstin,
                    'credit_limit' => $data['credit_limit'] ?? $existingCustomer->credit_limit,
                ]);
                $results['updated']++;
            } else {
                Customer::create([
                    'name' => $data['name'],
                    'mobile' => $data['mobile'],
                    'email' => $data['email'] ?? null,
                    'address' => $data['address'] ?? null,
                    'gstin' => $data['gstin'] ?? null,
                    'credit_limit' => $data['credit_limit'] ?? 0,
                    'created_by' => auth()->id(),
                ]);
                $results['created']++;
            }
        }

        fclose($handle);

        return response()->json([
            'message' => 'Import completed',
            'results' => $results,
        ]);
    }

        $exportData = $customers->map(function ($customer) {

                'total_spent' => $customer->total_spent,

                'advance_received' => $customer->advance_received,

                'created_at' => $customer->created_at->format('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
                'created_by' => $customer->createdBy?->name ?? '',
            ];
        });

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,

        ]);

    public function import(Request $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $request->validate([
            'file' => 'required|file|mimes:csv,txt|max:10240',
        ]);

        $file = $request->file('file');
        $handle = fopen($file->getPathname(), 'r');

        $headers = fgetcsv($handle);
        if (!$headers) {
            return response()->json(['message' => 'Invalid CSV file'], 422);
        }

        $headers = array_map('strtolower', array_map('trim', $headers));

        $requiredFields = ['name', 'mobile'];
        foreach ($requiredFields as $field) {
            if (!in_array($field, $headers)) {
                return response()->json(['message' => "Missing required field: {$field}"], 422);
            }
        }

        $results = [
            'created' => 0,
            'updated' => 0,
            'skipped' => 0,
            'errors' => [],
        ];

        $rowNumber = 1;
        while (($row = fgetcsv($handle)) !== false) {
            $rowNumber++;
            $data = array_combine($headers, $row);

            if (empty($data['name']) || empty($data['mobile'])) {
                $results['errors'][] = "Row {$rowNumber}: Name and mobile are required";
                $results['skipped']++;
                continue;
            }

            $validator = Validator::make($data, [
                'name' => 'required|string|max:255',
                'mobile' => 'required|string|max:20',
                'email' => 'nullable|email',
                'gstin' => 'nullable|string|max:20',
                'address' => 'nullable|string',
                'credit_limit' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0',
            ]);

            if ($validator->fails()) {
                $results['errors'][] = "Row {$rowNumber}: " . implode(', ', $validator->errors()->all());
                $results['skipped']++;
                continue;
            }

            $existingCustomer = Customer::where('mobile', $data['mobile'])->first();

            if ($existingCustomer) {
                $existingCustomer->update([
                    'name' => $data['name'],
                    'email' => $data['email'] ?? $existingCustomer->email,
                    'address' => $data['address'] ?? $existingCustomer->address,
                    'gstin' => $data['gstin'] ?? $existingCustomer->gstin,
                    'credit_limit' => $data['credit_limit'] ?? $existingCustomer->credit_limit,
                ]);
                $results['updated']++;
            } else {
                Customer::create([
                    'name' => $data['name'],
                    'mobile' => $data['mobile'],
                    'email' => $data['email'] ?? null,
                    'address' => $data['address'] ?? null,
                    'gstin' => $data['gstin'] ?? null,
                    'credit_limit' => $data['credit_limit'] ?? 0,
                    'created_by' => auth()->id(),
                ]);
                $results['created']++;
            }
        }

        fclose($handle);

        return response()->json([
            'message' => 'Import completed',
            'results' => $results,
        ]);
    }

    public function getAnalytics(): JsonResponse
    {
        $now = now();
        $thirtyDaysAgo = $now->copy()->subDays(30);
        $ninetyDaysAgo = $now->copy()->subDays(90);

        $newCustomers = Customer::where('created_at', '>=', $thirtyDaysAgo)->count();
        $activeCustomers = Customer::whereHas('invoices', function ($q) use ($thirtyDaysAgo) {
            $q->where('invoice_date', '>=', $thirtyDaysAgo);
        })->count();
        $inactiveCustomers = Customer::whereDoesntHave('invoices', function ($q) use ($ninetyDaysAgo) {
            $q->where('invoice_date', '>=', $ninetyDaysAgo);
        })->count();

        $tierDistribution = Customer::selectRaw('customer_tier_id, COUNT(*) as count')
            ->groupBy('customer_tier_id')
            ->with('customerTier:id,name,color')
            ->get()
            ->map(function ($item) {
                return [
                    'tier_id' => $item->customer_tier_id,
                    'tier_name' => $item->customerTier?->name ?? 'No Tier',
                    'tier_color' => $item->customerTier?->color ?? '#9ca3af',
                    'count' => $item->count,
                ];
            });

        $monthlyTrend = Customer::selectRaw('DATE_FORMAT(created_at, "%Y-%m") as month, COUNT(*) as count')
            ->where('created_at', '>=', $now->copy()->subMonths(12))
            ->groupBy('month')
            ->orderBy('month')
            ->get();

        $topCustomers = Customer::orderByDesc('total_spent')
            ->limit(10)
            ->get(['id', 'name', 'mobile', 'total_spent', 'customer_tier_id'])
            ->load('customerTier:id,name,color');

        return response()->json([
            'new_customers_30d' => $newCustomers,
            'active_customers_30d' => $activeCustomers,
            'inactive_customers_90d' => $inactiveCustomers,
            'tier_distribution' => $tierDistribution,
            'monthly_trend' => $monthlyTrend,
            'top_customers' => $topCustomers,
        ]);
    }

    public function getStatement(Request $request, Customer $customer): JsonResponse
    {
        $fromDate = $request->input('from_date');
        $toDate = $request->input('to_date');

        $invoices = Invoice::where('customer_mobile', $customer->mobile)
            ->when($fromDate, fn($q) => $q->whereDate('invoice_date', '>=', $fromDate))
            ->when($toDate, fn($q) => $q->whereDate('invoice_date', '<=', $toDate))
            ->orderBy('invoice_date', 'desc')
            ->get();

        $transactions = [];
        foreach ($invoices as $invoice) {
            $transactions[] = [
                'id' => $invoice->id,
                'date' => $invoice->invoice_date,
                'type' => 'invoice',
                'reference' => $invoice->invoice_number,
                'description' => 'Sale - Invoice #' . $invoice->invoice_number,
                'debit' => $invoice->total,
                'credit' => $invoice->amount_received,
                'balance' => $invoice->balance_due,
            ];
        }

        return response()->json([
            'data' => $transactions,
        ]);
    }

    public function index(Request $request)

            ->when($request->status, fn($q, $s) => $q->where('status', $s))
            ->when($request->start_date, fn($q, $d) => $q->whereDate('expense_date', '>=', $d))
            ->when($request->end_date, fn($q, $d) => $q->whereDate('expense_date', '<=', $d))
            ->when($request->search, fn($q, $s) => $q->where('description', 'like', "%{$s}%"))
            ->orderByDesc('expense_date');

            'data' => $expenses,

    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'category_id' => 'required|exists:expense_categories,id',
            'account_id' => 'required|exists:accounts,id',
            'payment_account_id' => 'required|exists:accounts,id',
            'amount' => 'required|numeric|min:0.01',
            'gst_percent' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0|max:28',
            'expense_date' => 'required|date',
            'description' => 'required|string|max:500',
            'payment_mode' => 'nullable|in:cash,bank,upi,card,cheque',
            'reference_number' => 'nullable|string|max:100',
            'notes' => 'nullable|string',
        ]);

        $account = \App\Models\Account::find($validated['account_id']);
        if ($account->type !== 'expense') {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'The account_id must be an expense-type account',
            ], 422);
        }

        $paymentAccount = \App\Models\Account::find($validated['payment_account_id']);
        if ($paymentAccount->type !== 'asset') {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'The payment_account_id must be an asset-type account',
            ], 422);
        }

        try {
            $expense = Expense::createWithJournal($validated);

            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => 'Expense recorded successfully',
                'data' => $expense->load(['category', 'account', 'paymentAccount']),
            ], 201);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Failed to create expense: ' . $e->getMessage(),
            ], 422);
        }
    }

                'message' => 'Cannot edit posted expense',
            ], 422);

            'account_id' => 'required|exists:accounts,id',

            'amount' => 'required|numeric|min:0.01',
            'expense_date' => 'required|date',
            'description' => 'required|string|max:500',
            'payment_mode' => 'nullable|in:cash,bank,upi,card,cheque',

            'message' => 'Expense updated successfully',

                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Cannot delete posted expense. Cancel it instead.',
            ], 422);
        }

        $expense->delete();

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'message' => 'Expense deleted successfully',

    }

    public function cancel(Expense $expense)
    {
        if ($expense->status !== Expense::STATUS_POSTED) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Can only cancel posted expenses',
            ], 422);
        }

        DB::transaction(function () use ($expense) {
            // Delete the transaction
            if ($expense->transaction) {
                $expense->transaction->delete();
            }

            // Reverse account balances
            $expenseAccount = Account::find($expense->account_id);
            $expenseAccount->current_balance = $expenseAccount->current_balance - $expense->amount;
            $expenseAccount->save();

            $paymentAccount = Account::find($expense->payment_account_id);
            $paymentAccount->current_balance = $paymentAccount->current_balance + $expense->amount;
            $paymentAccount->save();

            $expense->status = Expense::STATUS_CANCELLED;
            $expense->save();
        });

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'message' => 'Expense cancelled successfully',
            'data' => $expense,
        ]);

        if (!$expenseRecurring->is_active) {
            return response()->json([

                'message' => 'Recurring expense is not active',

        try {

            $expenseRecurring->advanceNextDueDate();

    public function dashboard()
    {
        $today = now()->toDateString();
        $weekStart = now()->startOfWeek()->toDateString();
        $weekEnd = now()->endOfWeek()->toDateString();
        $monthStart = now()->startOfMonth()->toDateString();
        $monthEnd = now()->endOfMonth()->toDateString();

        $stats = [
            'today' => Expense::posted()->whereDate('expense_date', $today)->sum('amount'),
            'this_week' => Expense::posted()->whereBetween('expense_date', [$weekStart, $weekEnd])->sum('amount'),
            'this_month' => Expense::posted()->whereBetween('expense_date', [$monthStart, $monthEnd])->sum('amount'),
            'total' => Expense::posted()->sum('amount'),
        ];

        $byCategory = Expense::posted()
            ->whereBetween('expense_date', [$monthStart, $monthEnd])
            ->selectRaw('category_id, SUM(amount) as total')
            ->groupBy('category_id')
            ->with('category')
            ->get()
            ->map(fn($item) => [
                'category' => $item->category->name ?? 'Unknown',
                'amount' => $item->total,
            ]);

        $recentExpenses = Expense::with(['category', 'paymentAccount'])
            ->posted()
            ->orderByDesc('expense_date')
            ->limit(10)
            ->get();

        $upcomingRecurring = ExpenseRecurring::active()
            ->whereDate('next_due_date', '<=', now()->addDays(7))
            ->with(['category'])
            ->get()
            ->map(fn($r) => [
                'id' => $r->id,
                'name' => $r->name,
                'category' => $r->category->name ?? 'Unknown',
                'amount' => $r->amount,
                'next_due_date' => $r->next_due_date->format('Y-m-d'),
                'frequency' => $r->frequency_label,
            ]);

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'data' => [
                'stats' => $stats,
                'by_category' => $byCategory,
                'recent_expenses' => $recentExpenses,
                'upcoming_recurring' => $upcomingRecurring,
            ],
        ]);
    }

    public function getAccounts()
    {
        // Only show accounts that can actually be used for payments
        // Include Cash, Bank, and other liquid accounts
        // Exclude: Assets, Current Assets, Inventory, Accounts Receivable
        $allowedAccounts = ['Cash', 'Bank', 'Petty Cash', 'UPI', 'Cards'];
        
        $accounts = Account::where('type', 'asset')
            ->whereIn('name', $allowedAccounts)
            ->orderBy('name')
            ->get(['id', 'name', 'code', 'type']);

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'data' => $accounts,
        ]);
    }

    public function getExpenseAccounts()
    {
        // Get expense accounts for double-entry accounting
        $accounts = Account::where('type', 'expense')
            ->where('parent_id', '!=', null) // Exclude parent "Expenses" account
            ->orderBy('name')
            ->get(['id', 'name', 'code', 'type']);

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'data' => $accounts,
        ]);
    }

        $monthStart = now()->startOfMonth()->toDateString();

            'today' => Expense::posted()->whereDate('expense_date', $today)->sum('amount'),
            'this_week' => Expense::posted()->whereBetween('expense_date', [$weekStart, $weekEnd])->sum('amount'),
            'this_month' => Expense::posted()->whereBetween('expense_date', [$monthStart, $monthEnd])->sum('amount'),
            'total' => Expense::posted()->sum('amount'),

        $byCategory = Expense::posted()
            ->whereBetween('expense_date', [$monthStart, $monthEnd])

            ->groupBy('category_id')
            ->with('category')
            ->get()

            ],

    public function getAccounts()
    {

        // Include Cash, Bank, and other liquid accounts
        // Exclude: Assets, Current Assets, Inventory, Accounts Receivable
        $allowedAccounts = ['Cash', 'Bank', 'Petty Cash', 'UPI', 'Cards'];

            ->orderBy('name')
            ->get(['id', 'name', 'code', 'type']);

            'data' => $accounts,

            ->where('parent_id', '!=', null) // Exclude parent "Expenses" account
            ->orderBy('name')
            ->get(['id', 'name', 'code', 'type']);

            'success' => true,
            'data' => $accounts,
        ]);
    }

                    $pointsEarned = floor($invoice->grand_total / $settings->rupees_per_point);
                    if ($pointsEarned > 0) {
                        $customer = CustomerPoints::getOrCreate($validated['customer_mobile'], $validated['customer_name']);
                        $customer->earnPoints($pointsEarned, $invoice->id, "Earned {$pointsEarned} points from invoice {$invoice->invoice_number}");
                        $loyaltyData = [
                            'points_earned' => $pointsEarned,
                            'total_points' => $customer->available_points,
                        ];
                    }
                }

                // Update customer total_spent and auto-assign tier (race-condition safe)
                $customerEntity = Customer::where('mobile', $validated['customer_mobile'])->first();
                if ($customerEntity) {
                    $customerEntity->increment('total_spent', $invoice->grand_total);
                    $customerEntity->refresh();
                    $customerEntity->assignEligibleTier();
                    
                    // Update customer outstanding balance
                    if (!$invoice->is_cancelled) {
                        CustomerLedgerService::updateCustomerOutstanding($validated['customer_mobile']);
                    }
                    
                    // Return tier upgrade info if tier changed
                    if ($customerEntity->wasChanged('customer_tier_id')) {
                        $tierUpgrade = [
                            'old_tier_id' => $customerEntity->getOriginal('customer_tier_id'),
                            'new_tier_id' => $customerEntity->customer_tier_id,
                            'new_tier_name' => $customerEntity->customerTier?->name,
                            'new_tier_color' => $customerEntity->customerTier?->color,
                        ];
                    }
                }
            }

            // AUDIT LOG - Record invoice creation
            AuditLog::create([
                'action' => 'create',
                'model_type' => Invoice::class,
                'model_id' => $invoice->id,
                'user_id' => auth()->id(),
                'old_data' => null,
                'new_data' => json_encode([
                    'invoice_number' => $invoice->invoice_number,
                    'customer_name' => $invoice->customer_name,
                    'grand_total' => $invoice->grand_total,
                    'item_count' => count($validated['items']),
                ]),
                'ip_address' => $request->ip(),
                'user_agent' => $request->userAgent(),
            ]);

            // Note: Accounting posting already handled inside transaction (line 349)

            $invoiceResource = new InvoiceResource($invoice->load('items'));
            $responseData = $invoiceResource->resolve($request);
            if ($loyaltyData) {
                $responseData['loyalty'] = $loyaltyData;
            }
            if ($tierUpgrade) {
                $responseData['tier_upgrade'] = $tierUpgrade;
            }
            if (!empty($serialErrors)) {
                $responseData['warnings'] = $serialErrors;
            }
            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'data' => $responseData,
            ]);
        } catch (\Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException $e) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Validation failed',
                'errors' => $e->errors(),
            ], 422);
        } catch (QueryException $e) {
            // Handle deadlock specifically
            if ($e->getCode() === '40001' || str_contains($e->getMessage(), 'Deadlock')) {
                Log::warning('Invoice creation deadlock detected, please retry', [
                    'idempotency_key' => $request->idempotency_key ?? 'N/A',
                    'trace' => $e->getTraceAsString(),
                ]);
                return response()->json([
                    'success' => false,
                    'message' => 'Transaction conflict. Please retry the request.',
                    'retry' => true,
                ], 409); // 409 Conflict
            }
            throw $e;
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            \Log::error('Invoice creation failed: ' . $e->getMessage(), [
                'trace' => $e->getTraceAsString(),
            ]);
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Failed to create invoice: ' . $e->getMessage(),
            ], 500);
        }
    }

    public function recordPayment(Request $request)
    {
        try {
            $validated = $request->validate([
                'invoice_id' => 'required|integer',
                'amount' => 'required|numeric|min:1',
                'payment_mode' => 'required|in:Cash,UPI,Card,Credit,Other',
                'idempotency_key' => 'nullable|string|max:100',
            ]);

            // Use transaction with row locking to prevent concurrent payments
            $result = \DB::transaction(function () use ($validated) {
                // Lock the invoice row for update to prevent concurrent modifications
                $invoice = Invoice::where('id', $validated['invoice_id'])
                    ->lockForUpdate()
                    ->first();
                
                if (!$invoice) {
                    return ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Invoice not found', 'status' => 404];
                }

                // Check if invoice is already paid or cancelled
                if ($invoice->payment_status === 'Paid' || $invoice->payment_status === 'Cancelled') {
                    return [
                        'success' => false, 
                        'message' => 'Cannot record payment on ' . strtolower($invoice->payment_status) . ' invoice',
                        'status' => 400
                    ];
                }

                // Calculate maximum allowed payment (prevent overpayment)
                $maxAllowed = $invoice->balance_due;
                
                // Validate amount doesn't exceed balance due
                if ($validated['amount'] > $maxAllowed) {
                    return [
                        'success' => false, 
                        'message' => 'Payment amount (₹' . $validated['amount'] . ') exceeds balance due (₹' . $maxAllowed . '). Maximum allowed: ₹' . $maxAllowed,
                        'status' => 400
                    ];
                }

                // Idempotency check - prevent duplicate payments
                if (!empty($validated['idempotency_key'])) {
                    $existingPayment = \DB::table('payment_records')
                        ->where('idempotency_key', $validated['idempotency_key'])
                        ->first();
                    if ($existingPayment) {
                        return [
                            'success' => true,
                            'message' => 'Payment already recorded (idempotent response)',
                            'duplicate' => true,
                            'invoice' => $invoice,
                            'status' => 200
                        ];
                    }
                }

                $newAmountReceived = $invoice->amount_received + $validated['amount'];
                $newBalanceDue = $invoice->grand_total - $newAmountReceived;

                $paymentStatus = 'Pending';
                if ($newBalanceDue <= 0) {
                    $paymentStatus = 'Paid';
                    $newBalanceDue = 0;
                } elseif ($newAmountReceived > 0) {
                    $paymentStatus = 'Partially Paid';
                }

                $invoice->update([
                    'amount_received' => $newAmountReceived,
                    'balance_due' => $newBalanceDue,
                    'payment_status' => $paymentStatus,
                    'payment_mode' => $validated['payment_mode'],
                ]);

                // Record payment with idempotency key
                if (!empty($validated['idempotency_key'])) {
                    \DB::table('payment_records')->insert([
                        'invoice_id' => $invoice->id,
                        'amount' => $validated['amount'],
                        'payment_mode' => $validated['payment_mode'],
                        'idempotency_key' => $validated['idempotency_key'],
                        'created_at' => now(),
                        'updated_at' => now(),
                    ]);
                }

                // Post accounting transaction for the payment
                try {
                    AccountingService::postInvoicePayment($invoice, $validated['amount'], $validated['payment_mode']);
                } catch (\Exception $e) {
                    \Log::error('Payment accounting error: ' . $e->getMessage());
                }

                // Update customer outstanding after payment
                CustomerLedgerService::updateCustomerOutstanding($invoice->customer_mobile);

                return [
                    'success' => true,
                    'message' => 'Payment recorded successfully',
                    'invoice' => $invoice,
                    'status' => 200
                ];
            });

            // Handle transaction result
            if (isset($result['status'])) {
                $statusCode = $result['status'];
                unset($result['status']);
                if (isset($result['invoice'])) {
                    $result['data'] = new InvoiceResource($result['invoice']->load('items'));
                    unset($result['invoice']);
                }
                return response()->json($result, $statusCode);
            }

            return response()->json([
                'success' => $result['success'],
                'message' => $result['message'],
                'data' => new InvoiceResource($result['invoice']->load('items')),
            ]);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Error: ' . $e->getMessage()
            ], 500);
        }
    }

    public function recordMultiPayment(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'payments' => 'required|array|min:1',
            'payments.*.invoice_id' => 'required|exists:invoices,id',
            'payments.*.amount' => 'required|numeric|min:1',
            'payment_mode' => 'required|in:Cash,UPI,Card,Credit,Other',
        ]);

        $results = [];

        foreach ($validated['payments'] as $payment) {
            $invoice = Invoice::findOrFail($payment['invoice_id']);

            $newAmountReceived = $invoice->amount_received + $payment['amount'];
            $newBalanceDue = $invoice->grand_total - $newAmountReceived;

            $paymentStatus = 'Pending';
            if ($newBalanceDue <= 0) {
                $paymentStatus = 'Paid';
                $newBalanceDue = 0;
            } elseif ($newAmountReceived > 0) {
                $paymentStatus = 'Partially Paid';
            }

            $invoice->update([
                'amount_received' => $newAmountReceived,
                'balance_due' => $newBalanceDue,
                'payment_status' => $paymentStatus,
                'payment_mode' => $validated['payment_mode'],
            ]);

            $results[] = new InvoiceResource($invoice->load('items'));
        }

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'message' => 'Payments recorded successfully',
            'data' => $results,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Process a refund on an invoice
     */
    public function refund(Request $request, Invoice $invoice)
    {
        try {
            $validated = $request->validate([
                'amount' => 'required|numeric|min:0.01',
                'reason' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
                'payment_mode' => 'nullable|in:Cash,UPI,Card,Credit,Other',
            ]);

            // Check if invoice is paid or partially paid
            if ($invoice->payment_status === 'Pending') {
                return response()->json([
                    'success' => false,
                    'message' => 'Cannot refund - invoice has no payments'
                ], 400);
            }

            if ($invoice->payment_status === 'Cancelled') {
                return response()->json([
                    'success' => false,
                    'message' => 'Cannot refund - invoice is cancelled'
                ], 400);
            }

            // Maximum refund is the amount received
            $maxRefund = $invoice->amount_received;
            
            if ($validated['amount'] > $maxRefund) {
                return response()->json([
                    'success' => false,
                    'message' => "Refund amount (₹{$validated['amount']}) exceeds amount received (₹{$maxRefund}). Maximum refund: ₹{$maxRefund}"
                ], 400);
            }

            // Process refund within transaction
            $result = \DB::transaction(function () use ($invoice, $validated) {
                // Lock invoice for update
                $lockedInvoice = Invoice::where('id', $invoice->id)
                    ->lockForUpdate()
                    ->first();

                // Recalculate after lock
                $newAmountReceived = $lockedInvoice->amount_received - $validated['amount'];
                $newBalanceDue = $lockedInvoice->grand_total - $newAmountReceived;

                // Determine new payment status
                $paymentStatus = 'Pending';
                if ($newAmountReceived <= 0) {
                    $paymentStatus = 'Pending';
                    $newAmountReceived = 0;
                    $newBalanceDue = $lockedInvoice->grand_total;
                } elseif ($newBalanceDue < $lockedInvoice->grand_total) {
                    $paymentStatus = 'Partially Paid';
                }

                // Update invoice
                $lockedInvoice->update([
                    'amount_received' => $newAmountReceived,
                    'balance_due' => $newBalanceDue,
                    'payment_status' => $paymentStatus,
                ]);

                // Record refund in payment_records table
                \DB::table('payment_records')->insert([
                    'invoice_id' => $lockedInvoice->id,
                    'amount' => -$validated['amount'], // Negative for refund
                    'payment_mode' => $validated['payment_mode'] ?? 'Cash',
                    'idempotency_key' => 'refund-' . uniqid(),
                    'reference_number' => 'REF-' . date('Ymd') . '-' . rand(1000, 9999),
                    'notes' => $validated['reason'] ?? 'Refund processed',
                    'created_at' => now(),
                    'updated_at' => now(),
                ]);

                return [
                    'invoice' => $lockedInvoice,
                    'refund_amount' => $validated['amount'],
                    'new_status' => $paymentStatus,
                ];
            });

            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => 'Refund processed successfully',
                'data' => [
                    'invoice' => new InvoiceResource($result['invoice']->load('items')),
                    'refund_amount' => $result['refund_amount'],
                    'previous_received' => $result['invoice']->amount_received + $result['refund_amount'],
                    'new_received' => $result['invoice']->amount_received,
                    'new_balance_due' => $result['invoice']->balance_due,
                    'payment_status' => $result['new_status'],
                ]
            ]);

        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Error: ' . $e->getMessage()
            ], 500);
        }
    }
