                'ship_to_state' => 'nullable|string',
                'ship_to_state_code' => 'nullable|string|max:10',
                'vehicle_number' => 'nullable|string|max:20',
                'lr_number' => 'nullable|string|max:50',
                'eway_bill_number' => 'nullable|string|max:50',
                'is_interstate' => 'nullable|boolean',
                'discount_type' => 'nullable|in:flat,percent',
                'amount_in_words' => 'nullable|string',
                'invoice_template_id' => 'nullable|exists:invoice_templates,id',
                'credit_to_apply' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0',
                'points_to_redeem' => 'nullable|integer|min:0',
                'items' => 'required|array|min:1',
                'items.*.cartItemId' => 'nullable|string',
                'items.*.product_id' => 'nullable|exists:products,id',
                'items.*.variant_id' => 'nullable|exists:product_variants,id',
                'items.*.name' => 'required|string',
                'items.*.hsn_code' => 'nullable|string|max:20',
                'items.*.gst_rate' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0|max:100',
                'items.*.cgst' => 'nullable|numeric',
                'items.*.sgst' => 'nullable|numeric',
                'items.*.igst' => 'nullable|numeric',
                'items.*.tax_amount' => 'nullable|numeric',
                'items.*.price_source' => 'nullable|string|max:50',
                'items.*.price_source_name' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
                'items.*.manual_override' => 'nullable|boolean',
                'items.*.quantity' => 'required|numeric|min:0',
                'items.*.unit_price' => 'required|numeric|min:0',
                'items.*.discount' => 'numeric|min:0',
                'items.*.total' => 'required|numeric|min:0',
                'items.*.serial_numbers' => 'nullable|array',
                'items.*.serial_numbers.*' => 'string|max:100',
                'items.*.batch_number' => 'nullable|string|max:50',
                'items.*.expiry_date' => 'nullable|date',
                'items.*.cost_price' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0',
                'items.*.cost_source' => 'nullable|string|in:fifo,avg,batch,serial,manual',
                'sub_total' => 'required|numeric',
                'cgst' => 'nullable|numeric',
                'sgst' => 'nullable|numeric',
                'igst' => 'nullable|numeric',
                'total_tax' => 'nullable|numeric',
                'total_discount' => 'numeric|min:0',
                'grand_total' => 'required|numeric',
                'round_off' => 'numeric',
                'amount_received' => 'required|numeric|min:0',
                'balance_due' => 'nullable|numeric',
                'payment_status' => 'required|in:Paid,Pending,Partially Paid',
                'payment_mode' => 'required|in:Cash,UPI,Card,Credit,Other',
                'notes' => 'nullable|string',
            ]);

            // IDEMPOTENCY CHECK - Prevent duplicate invoice creation
            if (!empty($validated['idempotency_key'])) {
                $existing = Invoice::where('idempotency_key', $validated['idempotency_key'])->first();
                if ($existing) {
                    // Return existing invoice - request was already processed
                    return response()->json([
                        'success' => true,
                        'data' => new InvoiceResource($existing->load('items')),
                        'message' => 'Invoice already created (idempotent response)',
                        'duplicate' => true,
                    ]);
                }
            }

            // Load customer if provided (invoices.customer_id references customers table)
            $creditApplied = 0;
            $pointsRedeemed = 0;
            $customer = null;

            if (!empty($validated['customer_id'])) {
                $customer = \App\Models\Customer::find($validated['customer_id']);
            }

            // Apply credit only when explicitly requested
            if ($customer && !empty($validated['credit_to_apply'])) {
                $availableCredit = $customer->credit_balance + $customer->advance_received;
                $creditApplied = min($validated['credit_to_apply'], $availableCredit, $validated['grand_total']);
            }

            $validated['credit_applied'] = $creditApplied;
            $validated['customer_id'] = $customer?->id;
            $validated['idempotency_key'] = $validated['idempotency_key'] ?? Str::uuid()->toString();

            // Generate invoice number if not provided (match `nextInvoiceNumber()` format)
            if (empty($validated['invoice_number'])) {
                $user = auth()->user();
                $branchId = $request->user_branch_id ?? $request->header('X-Branch-ID');
                $posSettings = \App\Models\PosSetting::getForCompany($user->company_id, $branchId);
                $prefix = $posSettings?->bill_prefix ?: 'INV';

                $query = Invoice::where('company_id', $user->company_id);
                if ($branchId) {
                    $query->where('branch_id', $branchId);
                }

                $count = $query->count();
                $nextNumber = str_pad($count + 1, 4, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
                $validated['invoice_number'] = $prefix . '/' . $nextNumber;
            }

            // Set default template if not provided
            if (empty($validated['invoice_template_id'])) {
                $defaultTemplate = \App\Models\InvoiceTemplate::where('company_id', auth()->user()->company_id)
                    ->where('is_default', true)
                    ->first();
                if ($defaultTemplate) {
                    $validated['invoice_template_id'] = $defaultTemplate->id;
                }
            }

            // Set branch_id from middleware
            if ($request->user_branch_id) {
                $validated['branch_id'] = $request->user_branch_id;
            }

            // Calculate balance_due if not provided
            // balance_due = grand_total - amount_received - credit_applied
            // Ensure balance_due is never negative (if amount_received > grand_total, set to 0)
            if (!isset($validated['balance_due'])) {
                $calculatedBalance = $validated['grand_total'] 
                    - ($validated['amount_received'] ?? 0) 
                    - ($creditApplied ?? 0);
                $validated['balance_due'] = max(0, $calculatedBalance);
            }

            // DEADLOCK RETRY: Use transaction with retry attempts
            $invoice = null;
            $serialErrors = [];
            $batchErrors = [];

            $invoice = DB::transaction(function () use ($validated, $customer, $creditApplied, &$serialErrors, &$batchErrors) {
                if ($customer && $creditApplied > 0 && !$customer->useCredit($creditApplied)) {
                    throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                        'credit_to_apply' => 'Insufficient customer credit available.',
                    ]);
                }

                $invoice = Invoice::create($validated);

                foreach ($validated['items'] as $itemData) {
                    // Store serial numbers in invoice_items
                    $invoiceItemData = $itemData;
                    $serialNumbersJson = null;
                    if (!empty($itemData['serial_numbers'])) {
                        $serialNumbersJson = json_encode($itemData['serial_numbers']);
                    }
                    unset($invoiceItemData['serial_numbers']);

                    // Calculate cost using CostingEngine
                    $product = Product::find($itemData['product_id']);
                    $costingEngine = new CostingEngine();
                    $costSource = $itemData['cost_source'] ?? CostingEngine::COST_SOURCE_MANUAL;
                    $costPrice = $itemData['cost_price'] ?? 0;

                    // If no cost provided, calculate based on tracking type
                    if ($costPrice <= 0 && $product) {
                        $costData = $costingEngine->getConsumptionCost(
                            $product,
                            $itemData['quantity'],
                            $validated['branch_id'] ?? null,
                            [
                                'batch_id' => $itemData['batch_id'] ?? null,
                                'variant_id' => $itemData['variant_id'] ?? null,
                            ]
                        );
                        $costPrice = $costData['cost'];
                        $costSource = $costData['source'];
                    }

                    InvoiceItem::create([
                        'invoice_id' => $invoice->id,
                        'product_id' => $itemData['product_id'],
                        'variant_id' => $itemData['variant_id'] ?? null,
                        'hsn_code' => $itemData['hsn_code'] ?? null,
                        'gst_rate' => $itemData['gst_rate'] ?? null,
                        'cgst' => $itemData['cgst'] ?? null,
                        'sgst' => $itemData['sgst'] ?? null,
                        'igst' => $itemData['igst'] ?? null,
                        'tax_amount' => $itemData['tax_amount'] ?? null,
                        'price_source' => $itemData['price_source'] ?? null,
                        'price_source_name' => $itemData['price_source_name'] ?? null,
                        'manual_override' => $itemData['manual_override'] ?? false,
                        'name' => $itemData['name'],
                        'quantity' => $itemData['quantity'],
                        'unit_price' => $itemData['unit_price'],
                        'discount' => $itemData['discount'] ?? 0,
                        'total' => $itemData['total'],
                        'batch_number' => $itemData['batch_number'] ?? null,
                        'expiry_date' => $itemData['expiry_date'] ?? null,
                        'serial_numbers' => $serialNumbersJson,
                        'cost_price' => $costPrice,
                        'cost_source' => $costSource,
                    ]);

                    $product = Product::find($itemData['product_id']);
                if ($product) {
                    // Handle SERIAL tracking
                    if ($product->tracking_type === 'serial' && !empty($itemData['serial_numbers'])) {
                        $serialNumbers = $itemData['serial_numbers'];
                        $qtyNeeded = $itemData['quantity'];
                        
                        if (count($serialNumbers) < $qtyNeeded) {
                            throw new \Exception("Product '{$product->name}' requires {$qtyNeeded} serial numbers, but only " . count($serialNumbers) . " provided.");
                        }
                        
                        // CRITICAL: Lock serials for update to prevent concurrent billing
                        // This prevents two users from selling the same serial simultaneously
                        $lockedSerials = ProductSerial::whereIn('serial_number', $serialNumbers)
                            ->where('product_id', $product->id)
                            ->lockForUpdate()
                            ->get();
                        
                        // Validate all serials exist and are available
                        $foundSerials = $lockedSerials->pluck('serial_number')->toArray();
                        $missingSerials = array_diff($serialNumbers, $foundSerials);
                        if (!empty($missingSerials)) {
                            throw new \Exception("Serial numbers not found: " . implode(', ', $missingSerials));
                        }
                        
                        // Validate status for each serial
                        foreach ($lockedSerials as $serial) {
                            if ($serial->status === 'sold') {
                                throw new \Exception("Serial number '{$serial->serial_number}' is already sold. Cannot sell again.");
                            }
                            if ($serial->status === 'damaged') {
                                throw new \Exception("Serial number '{$serial->serial_number}' is marked as damaged. Cannot sell.");
                            }
                            if ($serial->status === 'reserved') {
                                throw new \Exception("Serial number '{$serial->serial_number}' is reserved. Cannot sell.");
                            }
                        }
                        
                        // Mark all serials as sold
                        ProductSerial::whereIn('serial_number', $serialNumbers)
                            ->where('product_id', $product->id)
                            ->update(['status' => 'sold']);
                        
                        // Record stock movement for each serial
                        StockMovement::record([
                            'product_id' => $itemData['product_id'],
                            'variant_id' => $itemData['variant_id'] ?? null,
                            'type' => 'sale',
                            'quantity' => -$itemData['quantity'],
                            'batch_number' => implode(',', $serialNumbers),
                            'cost_price' => $itemData['cost_price'] ?? $product->purchase_price ?? 0,
                            'tracking_type' => 'serial',
                            'reason' => 'Sale',
                            'reference_type' => Invoice::class,
                            'reference_id' => $invoice->id,
                        ]);
                        
                        // Update product stock
                        if (!empty($itemData['variant_id'])) {
                            $variant = ProductVariant::find($itemData['variant_id']);
                            if ($variant) {
                                $variant->current_stock -= $itemData['quantity'];
                                $variant->save();
                            }
                        }
                        $product->current_stock -= $itemData['quantity'];
                        $product->save();
                    }
                    // Handle BATCH/FIFO tracking
                    elseif (in_array($product->tracking_type, ['batch', 'fifo']) && !empty($itemData['batch_number'])) {
                        $costingEngine = new CostingEngine();
                        
                        // Check expiry and log warning
                        $expiryWarning = $costingEngine->getExpiryWarning($itemData['expiry_date'] ?? null);
                        $isExpired = $costingEngine->isBatchExpired($itemData['expiry_date'] ?? null);
                        
                        // BLOCK EXPIRED if setting is enabled
                        $blockExpiredSales = \App\Models\AppSetting::getBool('block_expired_sales', false);
                        if ($isExpired && $blockExpiredSales) {
                            throw new \Exception("Cannot sell expired batch '{$itemData['batch_number']}'. Expiry date: {$itemData['expiry_date']}");
                        }
                        
                        if ($expiryWarning) {
                            Log::warning("Invoice batch expiry warning: {$itemData['batch_number']} - {$expiryWarning}");
                        }
                        
                        // Check available stock in batch
                        $availableBatches = $costingEngine->getAvailableBatches($product);
                        $batchStock = $availableBatches->where('batch_number', $itemData['batch_number'])->first();
                        
                        if (!$batchStock || $batchStock->available_qty < $itemData['quantity']) {
                            throw new \Exception("Insufficient stock in batch {$itemData['batch_number']}. Available: " . ($batchStock->available_qty ?? 0) . ", Requested: {$itemData['quantity']}");
                        }
                        
                        // Consume from batch via StockMovement
                        StockMovement::record([
                            'product_id' => $itemData['product_id'],
                            'variant_id' => $itemData['variant_id'] ?? null,
                            'type' => 'sale',
                            'quantity' => -$itemData['quantity'],
                            'batch_number' => $itemData['batch_number'],
                            'cost_price' => $itemData['cost_price'] ?? $product->purchase_price ?? 0,
                            'tracking_type' => $product->tracking_type,
                            'reason' => 'Sale',
                            'reference_type' => Invoice::class,
                            'reference_id' => $invoice->id,
                        ]);
                    }
                    // Handle AVERAGE or NONE tracking
                    else {
                        // Simple stock decrement
                        if (!empty($itemData['variant_id'])) {
                            $variant = ProductVariant::find($itemData['variant_id']);
                            if ($variant) {
                                $variant->current_stock -= $itemData['quantity'];
                                $variant->save();
                                $product->current_stock = ProductVariant::where('product_id', $product->id)->sum('current_stock');
                                $product->save();
                            }
                        } else {
                            $product->current_stock -= $itemData['quantity'];
                            $product->save();
                        }
                        
                        // Record stock movement
                        StockMovement::record([
                            'product_id' => $itemData['product_id'],
                            'variant_id' => $itemData['variant_id'] ?? null,
                            'type' => 'sale',
                            'quantity' => -$itemData['quantity'],
                            'cost_price' => $itemData['cost_price'] ?? $product->purchase_price ?? 0,
                            'tracking_type' => $product->tracking_type ?? 'average',
                            'reason' => 'Sale',
                            'reference_type' => Invoice::class,
                            'reference_id' => $invoice->id,
                        ]);
                    }
                }
                }
                
                return $invoice;
            }, 5);

            // Post accounting transactions
            AccountingService::postInvoice($invoice);

            // If paid immediately, also post payment
            if ($invoice->payment_status === 'Paid') {
                AccountingService::postInvoicePayment($invoice, $invoice->amount_received, $invoice->payment_mode);
            }

            // Credit accounting was done inside the transaction earlier

            // Award loyalty points if enabled and customer mobile exists
            $loyaltyData = null;
            $tierUpgrade = null;
            if ($validated['customer_mobile'] && !$invoice->is_cancelled) {
                $settings = CustomerLoyaltySettings::getSettings();
                if ($settings->is_enabled) {
                    $pointsEarned = floor($invoice->grand_total / $settings->rupees_per_point);
                    if ($pointsEarned > 0) {
                        $customer = CustomerPoints::getOrCreate($validated['customer_mobile'], $validated['customer_name']);
                        $customer->earnPoints($pointsEarned, $invoice->id, "Earned {$pointsEarned} points from invoice {$invoice->invoice_number}");
                        $loyaltyData = [
                            'points_earned' => $pointsEarned,
                            'total_points' => $customer->available_points,
                        ];
                    }
                }

                // Update customer total_spent and auto-assign tier (race-condition safe)
                $customerEntity = Customer::where('mobile', $validated['customer_mobile'])->first();
                if ($customerEntity) {
                    $customerEntity->increment('total_spent', $invoice->grand_total);
                    $customerEntity->refresh();
                    $customerEntity->assignEligibleTier();
                    
                    // Update customer outstanding balance
                    if (!$invoice->is_cancelled) {
                        CustomerLedgerService::updateCustomerOutstanding($validated['customer_mobile']);
                    }
                    
                    // Return tier upgrade info if tier changed
                    if ($customerEntity->wasChanged('customer_tier_id')) {
                        $tierUpgrade = [
                            'old_tier_id' => $customerEntity->getOriginal('customer_tier_id'),
                            'new_tier_id' => $customerEntity->customer_tier_id,
                            'new_tier_name' => $customerEntity->customerTier?->name,
                            'new_tier_color' => $customerEntity->customerTier?->color,
                        ];
                    }
                }
            }

            // AUDIT LOG - Record invoice creation
            AuditLog::create([
                'action' => 'create',
                'model_type' => Invoice::class,
                'model_id' => $invoice->id,
                'user_id' => auth()->id(),
                'old_data' => null,
                'new_data' => json_encode([
                    'invoice_number' => $invoice->invoice_number,
                    'customer_name' => $invoice->customer_name,
                    'grand_total' => $invoice->grand_total,
                    'item_count' => count($validated['items']),
                ]),
                'ip_address' => $request->ip(),
                'user_agent' => $request->userAgent(),
            ]);

            // Note: Accounting posting already handled inside transaction (line 349)

            $invoiceResource = new InvoiceResource($invoice->load('items'));
            $responseData = $invoiceResource->resolve($request);
            if ($loyaltyData) {
                $responseData['loyalty'] = $loyaltyData;
            }
            if ($tierUpgrade) {
                $responseData['tier_upgrade'] = $tierUpgrade;
            }
            if (!empty($serialErrors)) {
                $responseData['warnings'] = $serialErrors;
            }
            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'data' => $responseData,
            ]);
        } catch (\Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException $e) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Validation failed',
                'errors' => $e->errors(),
            ], 422);
        } catch (QueryException $e) {
            // Handle deadlock specifically
            if ($e->getCode() === '40001' || str_contains($e->getMessage(), 'Deadlock')) {
                Log::warning('Invoice creation deadlock detected, please retry', [
                    'idempotency_key' => $request->idempotency_key ?? 'N/A',
                    'trace' => $e->getTraceAsString(),
                ]);
                return response()->json([
                    'success' => false,
                    'message' => 'Transaction conflict. Please retry the request.',
                    'retry' => true,
                ], 409); // 409 Conflict
            }
            throw $e;
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            \Log::error('Invoice creation failed: ' . $e->getMessage(), [
                'trace' => $e->getTraceAsString(),
            ]);
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Failed to create invoice: ' . $e->getMessage(),
            ], 500);
        }
    }

    public function show(Invoice $invoice)
    {
        if ($invoice->company_id !== auth()->user()->company_id) {
            abort(403, 'Access denied');
        }
        return new InvoiceResource($invoice->load('items'));
    }

    public function update(Request $request, Invoice $invoice)
    {
        $editService = new InvoiceEditService();
        
        $canEdit = $editService->canEdit($invoice);
        if (!$canEdit['allowed']) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => $canEdit['reason'],
            ], 400);
        }

        $oldProfit = $editService->calculateInvoiceProfit($invoice)['total_profit'];
        $oldData = $invoice->only(['customer_name', 'customer_mobile', 'notes']);

        $validated = $request->validate([
            'customer_name' => 'sometimes|string',
            'customer_mobile' => 'nullable|string',
            'notes' => 'nullable|string',
            'edit_reason' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
        ]);

        $invoice->update($validated);

        $newProfit = $editService->calculateInvoiceProfit($invoice)['total_profit'];

        $editService->logEdit(
            $invoice,
            'invoice_updated',
            $oldData,
            $validated,
            $oldProfit,
            $newProfit,
            $validated['edit_reason'] ?? null,
            $request->ip(),
            $request->userAgent()
        );

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'message' => 'Invoice updated successfully',
            'data' => new InvoiceResource($invoice->load('items')),
            'profit' => [
                'old_profit' => $oldProfit,
                'new_profit' => $newProfit,
                'change' => $newProfit - $oldProfit,
            ]
        ]);
    }

    public function updateItem(Request $request, Invoice $invoice, InvoiceItem $item)
    {
        $editService = new InvoiceEditService();
        
        $canEdit = $editService->canEdit($invoice);
        if (!$canEdit['allowed']) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => $canEdit['reason'],
            ], 400);
        }

        if ($item->invoice_id !== $invoice->id) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Item does not belong to this invoice',
            ], 400);
        }

        $validated = $request->validate([
            'quantity' => 'sometimes|integer|min:1',
            'unit_price' => 'sometimes|numeric|min:0',
            'discount' => 'sometimes|numeric|min:0',
            'edit_reason' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
        ]);

        if (isset($validated['quantity']) || isset($validated['unit_price']) || isset($validated['discount'])) {
            $oldItem = $item->fresh();
            $oldTotal = ($oldItem->unit_price * $oldItem->quantity) - ($oldItem->discount ?? 0);
            $newUnitPrice = $validated['unit_price'] ?? $oldItem->unit_price;
            $newQuantity = $validated['quantity'] ?? $oldItem->quantity;
            $newDiscount = $validated['discount'] ?? ($oldItem->discount ?? 0);
            $validated['total'] = ($newUnitPrice * $newQuantity) - $newDiscount;
        }

        $result = $editService->updateItem(
            $invoice,
            $item,
            $validated,
            $validated['edit_reason'] ?? null,
            $request->ip(),
            $request->userAgent()
        );

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'message' => 'Item updated successfully',
            'data' => new InvoiceResource($invoice->load('items')),
            'profit' => [
                'old_profit' => $result['old_profit'],
                'new_profit' => $result['new_profit'],
                'change' => $result['profit_change'],
            ],
            'changes' => [
                'quantity_changed' => $result['quantity_changed'],
                'price_changed' => $result['price_changed'],
            ]
        ]);
    }

    public function getEditHistory(Invoice $invoice)
    {
        $editService = new InvoiceEditService();
        $history = $editService->getEditHistory($invoice);
        $profit = $editService->calculateInvoiceProfit($invoice);

        return response()->json([

    public function getItemProfit(Invoice $invoice, InvoiceItem $item)
    {
        if ($item->invoice_id !== $invoice->id) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Item does not belong to this invoice',
            ], 404);
        }

        $editService = new InvoiceEditService();
        $itemProfit = $editService->calculateItemProfit($item);
        $invoiceProfit = $editService->calculateInvoiceProfit($invoice);

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'data' => [
                'item' => [
                    'id' => $item->id,
                    'product_name' => $item->name,
                    'quantity' => $item->quantity,
                    'unit_price' => $item->unit_price,
                    'discount' => $item->discount ?? 0,
                    'cost_price' => $item->cost_price,
                    'cost_source' => $item->cost_source,
                ],
                'profit' => $itemProfit,
                'invoice_total_profit' => $invoiceProfit['total_profit'],
            ]
        ]);
    }

    public function cancel(Request $request, Invoice $invoice)
    {
        if ($invoice->is_cancelled) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Invoice is already cancelled',
            ], 400);
        }

        $validated = $request->validate([
            'cancellation_reason' => 'required|string|min:10',
        ]);

        $invoice->update([
            'is_cancelled' => true,
            'cancelled_at' => now(),
            'cancellation_reason' => $validated['cancellation_reason'],
            'payment_status' => 'Cancelled',
            'balance_due' => 0,
        ]);

        // Update customer outstanding after cancellation
        CustomerLedgerService::updateCustomerOutstanding($invoice->customer_mobile);

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'message' => 'Invoice cancelled successfully',
            'data' => new InvoiceResource($invoice->load('items')),
        ]);
    }

    public function getPaymentReceipt(Invoice $invoice)
    {
        $invoice->load('items');
        
        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'data' => [
                'invoice' => new InvoiceResource($invoice),
                'payments' => [
                    [
                        'amount' => $invoice->amount_received,
                        'payment_mode' => $invoice->payment_mode,
                        'payment_date' => $invoice->updated_at->format('Y-m-d H:i:s'),
                    ]
                ],
                'remaining_balance' => $invoice->balance_due,
            ],
        ]);
    }

    public function destroy(Invoice $invoice)
    {
        // Delete accounting entries (not reverse them - to keep reports accurate)
        \App\Models\AccountTransaction::where('reference_type', 'App\Models\Invoice')
            ->where('reference_id', $invoice->id)
            ->delete();

        $invoice->delete();

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'message' => 'Invoice deleted successfully',
        ]);
    }

    public function outstanding(Request $request)
    {
        $query = Invoice::with('items')
            ->whereIn('payment_status', ['Pending', 'Partially Paid'])
            ->where('balance_due', '>', 0);

        if ($request->has('customer_mobile')) {
            $query->where('customer_mobile', $request->customer_mobile);
        }

        if ($request->has('search')) {
            $search = $request->search;
            $query->where(function ($q) use ($search) {
                $q->where('invoice_number', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('customer_name', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('customer_mobile', 'like', "%{$search}%");
            });

        return response()->json([

            'data' => $invoices,
        ]);

    public function outstandingSummary()
    {

            ->selectRaw('COUNT(*) as invoice_count')
            ->selectRaw('SUM(grand_total) as total_amount')
            ->selectRaw('SUM(balance_due) as total_balance_due')
            ->whereIn('payment_status', ['Pending', 'Partially Paid'])
            ->where('balance_due', '>', 0)
            ->groupBy('customer_mobile', 'customer_name')
            ->orderByDesc('total_balance_due')
            ->get();

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'data' => $summary,
        ]);

    public function recordPayment(Request $request)
    {
        try {
            $validated = $request->validate([
                'invoice_id' => 'required|integer',
                'amount' => 'required|numeric|min:1',
                'payment_mode' => 'required|in:Cash,UPI,Card,Credit,Other',
                'idempotency_key' => 'nullable|string|max:100',
            ]);

            // Use transaction with row locking to prevent concurrent payments
            $result = \DB::transaction(function () use ($validated) {
                // Lock the invoice row for update to prevent concurrent modifications
                $invoice = Invoice::where('id', $validated['invoice_id'])
                    ->lockForUpdate()
                    ->first();
                
                if (!$invoice) {
                    return ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Invoice not found', 'status' => 404];
                }

                // Check if invoice is already paid or cancelled
                if ($invoice->payment_status === 'Paid' || $invoice->payment_status === 'Cancelled') {
                    return [
                        'success' => false, 
                        'message' => 'Cannot record payment on ' . strtolower($invoice->payment_status) . ' invoice',
                        'status' => 400
                    ];
                }

                // Calculate maximum allowed payment (prevent overpayment)
                $maxAllowed = $invoice->balance_due;
                
                // Validate amount doesn't exceed balance due
                if ($validated['amount'] > $maxAllowed) {
                    return [
                        'success' => false, 
                        'message' => 'Payment amount (₹' . $validated['amount'] . ') exceeds balance due (₹' . $maxAllowed . '). Maximum allowed: ₹' . $maxAllowed,
                        'status' => 400
                    ];
                }

                // Idempotency check - prevent duplicate payments
                if (!empty($validated['idempotency_key'])) {
                    $existingPayment = \DB::table('payment_records')
                        ->where('idempotency_key', $validated['idempotency_key'])
                        ->first();
                    if ($existingPayment) {
                        return [
                            'success' => true,
                            'message' => 'Payment already recorded (idempotent response)',
                            'duplicate' => true,
                            'invoice' => $invoice,
                            'status' => 200
                        ];
                    }
                }

                $newAmountReceived = $invoice->amount_received + $validated['amount'];
                $newBalanceDue = $invoice->grand_total - $newAmountReceived;

                $paymentStatus = 'Pending';
                if ($newBalanceDue <= 0) {
                    $paymentStatus = 'Paid';
                    $newBalanceDue = 0;
                } elseif ($newAmountReceived > 0) {
                    $paymentStatus = 'Partially Paid';
                }

                $invoice->update([
                    'amount_received' => $newAmountReceived,
                    'balance_due' => $newBalanceDue,
                    'payment_status' => $paymentStatus,
                    'payment_mode' => $validated['payment_mode'],
                ]);

                // Record payment with idempotency key
                if (!empty($validated['idempotency_key'])) {
                    \DB::table('payment_records')->insert([
                        'invoice_id' => $invoice->id,
                        'amount' => $validated['amount'],
                        'payment_mode' => $validated['payment_mode'],
                        'idempotency_key' => $validated['idempotency_key'],
                        'created_at' => now(),
                        'updated_at' => now(),
                    ]);
                }

                // Post accounting transaction for the payment
                try {
                    AccountingService::postInvoicePayment($invoice, $validated['amount'], $validated['payment_mode']);
                } catch (\Exception $e) {
                    \Log::error('Payment accounting error: ' . $e->getMessage());
                }

                // Update customer outstanding after payment
                CustomerLedgerService::updateCustomerOutstanding($invoice->customer_mobile);

                return [
                    'success' => true,
                    'message' => 'Payment recorded successfully',
                    'invoice' => $invoice,
                    'status' => 200
                ];
            });

            // Handle transaction result
            if (isset($result['status'])) {
                $statusCode = $result['status'];
                unset($result['status']);
                if (isset($result['invoice'])) {
                    $result['data'] = new InvoiceResource($result['invoice']->load('items'));
                    unset($result['invoice']);
                }
                return response()->json($result, $statusCode);
            }

            return response()->json([
                'success' => $result['success'],
                'message' => $result['message'],
                'data' => new InvoiceResource($result['invoice']->load('items')),
            ]);
        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Error: ' . $e->getMessage()
            ], 500);
        }
    }

    public function recordMultiPayment(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'payments' => 'required|array|min:1',
            'payments.*.invoice_id' => 'required|exists:invoices,id',
            'payments.*.amount' => 'required|numeric|min:1',
            'payment_mode' => 'required|in:Cash,UPI,Card,Credit,Other',
        ]);

        $results = [];

        foreach ($validated['payments'] as $payment) {
            $invoice = Invoice::findOrFail($payment['invoice_id']);

            $newAmountReceived = $invoice->amount_received + $payment['amount'];
            $newBalanceDue = $invoice->grand_total - $newAmountReceived;

            $paymentStatus = 'Pending';
            if ($newBalanceDue <= 0) {
                $paymentStatus = 'Paid';
                $newBalanceDue = 0;
            } elseif ($newAmountReceived > 0) {
                $paymentStatus = 'Partially Paid';
            }

            $invoice->update([
                'amount_received' => $newAmountReceived,
                'balance_due' => $newBalanceDue,
                'payment_status' => $paymentStatus,
                'payment_mode' => $validated['payment_mode'],
            ]);

            $results[] = new InvoiceResource($invoice->load('items'));
        }

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'message' => 'Payments recorded successfully',
            'data' => $results,
        ]);
    }

    /**
     * Process a refund on an invoice
     */
    public function refund(Request $request, Invoice $invoice)
    {
        try {
            $validated = $request->validate([
                'amount' => 'required|numeric|min:0.01',
                'reason' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
                'payment_mode' => 'nullable|in:Cash,UPI,Card,Credit,Other',
            ]);

            // Check if invoice is paid or partially paid
            if ($invoice->payment_status === 'Pending') {
                return response()->json([
                    'success' => false,
                    'message' => 'Cannot refund - invoice has no payments'
                ], 400);
            }

            if ($invoice->payment_status === 'Cancelled') {
                return response()->json([
                    'success' => false,
                    'message' => 'Cannot refund - invoice is cancelled'
                ], 400);
            }

            // Maximum refund is the amount received
            $maxRefund = $invoice->amount_received;
            
            if ($validated['amount'] > $maxRefund) {
                return response()->json([
                    'success' => false,
                    'message' => "Refund amount (₹{$validated['amount']}) exceeds amount received (₹{$maxRefund}). Maximum refund: ₹{$maxRefund}"
                ], 400);
            }

            // Process refund within transaction
            $result = \DB::transaction(function () use ($invoice, $validated) {
                // Lock invoice for update
                $lockedInvoice = Invoice::where('id', $invoice->id)
                    ->lockForUpdate()
                    ->first();

                // Recalculate after lock
                $newAmountReceived = $lockedInvoice->amount_received - $validated['amount'];
                $newBalanceDue = $lockedInvoice->grand_total - $newAmountReceived;

                // Determine new payment status
                $paymentStatus = 'Pending';
                if ($newAmountReceived <= 0) {
                    $paymentStatus = 'Pending';
                    $newAmountReceived = 0;
                    $newBalanceDue = $lockedInvoice->grand_total;
                } elseif ($newBalanceDue < $lockedInvoice->grand_total) {
                    $paymentStatus = 'Partially Paid';
                }

                // Update invoice
                $lockedInvoice->update([
                    'amount_received' => $newAmountReceived,
                    'balance_due' => $newBalanceDue,
                    'payment_status' => $paymentStatus,
                ]);

                // Record refund in payment_records table
                \DB::table('payment_records')->insert([
                    'invoice_id' => $lockedInvoice->id,
                    'amount' => -$validated['amount'], // Negative for refund
                    'payment_mode' => $validated['payment_mode'] ?? 'Cash',
                    'idempotency_key' => 'refund-' . uniqid(),
                    'reference_number' => 'REF-' . date('Ymd') . '-' . rand(1000, 9999),
                    'notes' => $validated['reason'] ?? 'Refund processed',
                    'created_at' => now(),
                    'updated_at' => now(),
                ]);

                return [
                    'invoice' => $lockedInvoice,
                    'refund_amount' => $validated['amount'],
                    'new_status' => $paymentStatus,
                ];
            });

            return response()->json([
                'success' => true,
                'message' => 'Refund processed successfully',
                'data' => [
                    'invoice' => new InvoiceResource($result['invoice']->load('items')),
                    'refund_amount' => $result['refund_amount'],
                    'previous_received' => $result['invoice']->amount_received + $result['refund_amount'],
                    'new_received' => $result['invoice']->amount_received,
                    'new_balance_due' => $result['invoice']->balance_due,
                    'payment_status' => $result['new_status'],
                ]
            ]);

        } catch (\Exception $e) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Error: ' . $e->getMessage()
            ], 500);
        }
    }

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\StoreProductRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\UpdateProductRequest;
use App\Http\Resources\ProductResource;
use App\Models\Product;
use App\Models\ProductVariant;
use App\Models\ProductBarcode;
use App\Models\StockMovement;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Http\Resources\Json\AnonymousResourceCollection;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;

class ProductController extends Controller
{
    public function nextItemCode(Request $request)
    {
        $prefix = $request->get('prefix', Product::getItemCodeSettings()['prefix']);
        $padding = (int) $request->get('padding', Product::getItemCodeSettings()['padding']);
        
        // Get the next item code
        $nextCode = Product::generateItemCode();
        
        // Get settings
        $settings = Product::getItemCodeSettings();
        
        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'data' => [
                'next_code' => $nextCode,
                'prefix' => $settings['prefix'],
                'padding' => $settings['padding'],
                'example' => $settings['prefix'] . str_pad(1, $settings['padding'], '0', STR_PAD_LEFT),
                'example_next' => $settings['prefix'] . str_pad(2, $settings['padding'], '0', STR_PAD_LEFT),
            ]
        ]);
    }

    public function index(Request $request): AnonymousResourceCollection
    {
        $query = Product::with(['supplier', 'variants.barcodes', 'category', 'brand', 'barcodes']);

        if ($request->has('category')) {
            $query->where('category', $request->category);
        }

        if ($request->has('category_id')) {
            $query->where('category_id', $request->category_id);
        }

        if ($request->has('search')) {
            $search = $request->search;
            $query->where(function ($q) use ($search) {
                $q->where('name', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('sku', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('brand', 'like', "%{$search}%");
            });
        }

        $products = $query->get();

        return ProductResource::collection($products);
    }

    public function search(Request $request): AnonymousResourceCollection
    {
        $query = Product::with(['supplier', 'variants.barcodes', 'category', 'brand', 'barcodes']);

        if ($request->has('barcode')) {
            $barcode = ProductBarcode::where('barcode', $request->barcode)->first();
            if ($barcode) {
                $query->where('id', $barcode->product_id);
                if ($barcode->variant_id) {
                    $query->with(['variants' => function ($q) use ($barcode) {
                        $q->where('id', $barcode->variant_id);
                    }]);
                }
            }
        }

        if ($request->has('q') || $request->has('search')) {
            $search = $request->get('q') ?? $request->get('search');
            $query->where(function ($q) use ($search) {
                $q->where('name', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('sku', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('barcode', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('brand', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('item_code', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhereHas('barcodes', function ($q) use ($search) {
                      $q->where('barcode', 'like', "%{$search}%");
                  });
            });
        }

        if ($request->has('category_id')) {
            $query->where('category_id', $request->category_id);
        }

        if ($request->has('brand_id')) {
            $query->where('brand_id', $request->brand_id);
        }

        if ($request->has('low_stock')) {
            $query->whereRaw('current_stock <= min_stock_level');
        }

        $limit = $request->get('limit', 50);
        $products = $query->take($limit)->get();

        return ProductResource::collection($products);
    }

    public function store(StoreProductRequest $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validated();

        // Check for duplicate variants (same size + color combination)
        if (!empty($validated['variants'])) {
            $combinations = [];
            foreach ($validated['variants'] as $index => $variant) {
                $size = $variant['size'] ?? '';
                $color = $variant['color'] ?? '';
                $key = strtolower(trim($size)) . '|' . strtolower(trim($color));
                if (isset($combinations[$key])) {
                    return response()->json([
                        'success' => false,
                        'message' => "Duplicate variant: Size '{$size}' and Color '{$color}' already exists at position " . ($combinations[$key] + 1),
                    ], 422);
                }
                $combinations[$key] = $index;
            }
        }

        // Generate SKU if not provided
        if (empty($validated['sku'])) {
            $validated['sku'] = 'SKU-' . strtoupper(uniqid());
        }

        // Generate item_code if not provided
        if (empty($validated['item_code'])) {
            $settings = Product::getItemCodeSettings();
            $validated['item_code'] = Product::generateItemCode();
            $validated['item_code_prefix'] = $settings['prefix'];
        } else {
            preg_match('/^([A-Za-z]+)/', $validated['item_code'], $matches);
            $validated['item_code_prefix'] = $matches[1] ?? 'item';
        }

        $validated['opening_stock'] = 0;
        $validated['current_stock'] = 0;

        $product = Product::create($validated);
        $this->syncPrimaryBarcode($product, $validated['barcode'] ?? null);

        if (isset($validated['is_variant_product']) && $validated['is_variant_product'] && isset($validated['variants'])) {
            foreach ($validated['variants'] as $variantData) {
                if (empty($variantData['sku'])) {
                    $variantData['sku'] = 'VAR-' . strtoupper(uniqid());
                }
                ProductVariant::create([
                    'product_id' => $product->id,
                    'current_stock' => 0,
                    ...$variantData,
                ]);
            }
        }

        $product->load(['supplier', 'variants.barcodes', 'barcodes']);
        foreach ($product->variants as $variant) {
            $this->syncVariantBarcode($product, $variant, $validated['variants'] ?? []);
        }
        $product->load(['supplier', 'variants.barcodes', 'barcodes']);

        return new ProductResource($product);
    }

    public function show(Product $product)
    {
        $product->load(['variants.barcodes']);
        foreach ($product->variants as $variant) {
            $this->syncVariantBarcode($product, $variant, $validated['variants'] ?? []);
        }

        return new ProductResource($product->load(['supplier', 'variants.barcodes', 'barcodes']));
    }

    public function update(UpdateProductRequest $request, Product $product)
    {
        $validated = $request->validated();

        // Check for duplicate variants (same size + color combination)
        if (!empty($validated['variants'])) {
            $combinations = [];
            foreach ($validated['variants'] as $index => $variant) {
                $key = strtolower(trim($variant['size'] ?? '')) . '|' . strtolower(trim($variant['color'] ?? ''));
                if (isset($combinations[$key])) {
                    return response()->json([
                        'success' => false,
                        'message' => "Duplicate variant: Size '{$variant['size']}' and Color '{$variant['color']}' already exists at position " . ($combinations[$key] + 1),
                    ], 422);
                }
                $combinations[$key] = $index;
            }
        }

        $product->update($validated);
        $this->syncPrimaryBarcode($product, $validated['barcode'] ?? $product->barcode);

        if (isset($validated['variants'])) {
            $existingVariants = $product->variants()->get()->keyBy('id');
            $submittedVariantIds = [];

            foreach ($validated['variants'] as $variantData) {
                $variantId = $variantData['id'] ?? null;
                if (empty($variantData['sku'])) {
                    $variantData['sku'] = 'VAR-' . strtoupper(uniqid());
                }

                unset($variantData['id']);

                if ($variantId && $existingVariants->has($variantId)) {
                    $submittedVariantIds[] = (int) $variantId;
                    $existingVariants[$variantId]->update($variantData);
                    continue;
                }

                $createdVariant = ProductVariant::create([
                    'product_id' => $product->id,
                    'current_stock' => 0,
                    ...$variantData,
                ]);
                $submittedVariantIds[] = $createdVariant->id;
            }

            $variantsToDelete = $existingVariants->reject(fn ($variant) => in_array($variant->id, $submittedVariantIds, true));
            foreach ($variantsToDelete as $variant) {
                if ((int) $variant->current_stock > 0) {
                    return response()->json([
                        'success' => false,
                        'message' => 'Cannot remove variant with existing stock. Adjust stock to zero first.',
                    ], 422);
                }
                $variant->delete();
            }
        }

        return new ProductResource($product->load(['supplier', 'variants', 'barcodes']));
    }

    public function destroy(Product $product)
    {
        $product->delete();

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'message' => 'Product deleted successfully',
        ]);
    }

    public function updateStock(Request $request, Product $product)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'quantity' => 'required|integer',
            'variant_id' => 'nullable|exists:product_variants,id',
            'warehouse_id' => 'nullable|exists:warehouses,id',
            'notes' => 'nullable|string',
        ]);

        $movement = StockMovement::record([
            'product_id' => $product->id,
            'variant_id' => $validated['variant_id'] ?? null,
            'warehouse_id' => $validated['warehouse_id'] ?? null,
            'type' => StockMovement::TYPE_ADJUSTMENT,
            'quantity' => $validated['quantity'],
            'reason' => 'manual',
            'reference_type' => 'product_stock_adjustment',
            'reference_id' => $product->id,
            'notes' => $validated['notes'] ?? 'Product stock updated',
        ]);

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'data' => (new ProductResource($product->fresh()->load(['supplier', 'variants.barcodes', 'barcodes']))),
            'movement_id' => $movement->id,
        ]);
    }

    private function syncVariantBarcode(Product $product, ProductVariant $variant, array $submittedVariants): void
    {
        $matchingInput = collect($submittedVariants)->first(function ($variantInput) use ($variant) {
            if (($variantInput['id'] ?? null) && (string) $variantInput['id'] === (string) $variant->id) {
                return true;
            }

            return ($variantInput['sku'] ?? null) === $variant->sku
                && ($variantInput['size'] ?? '') === $variant->size
                && ($variantInput['color'] ?? '') === $variant->color;
        });

        $barcode = trim((string) ($matchingInput['barcode'] ?? ''));

        $variant->barcodes()->delete();

        if ($barcode === '') {
            return;
        }

        $existingBarcode = ProductBarcode::where('barcode', $barcode)->first();

        if ($existingBarcode && (string) $existingBarcode->variant_id !== (string) $variant->id) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'barcode' => ["Variant barcode '{$barcode}' is already in use"],
            ]);
        }

        $variant->barcodes()->delete();

        ProductBarcode::create([
            'product_id' => $product->id,
            'variant_id' => $variant->id,
            'barcode' => $barcode,
            'barcode_type' => 'custom',
            'is_primary' => true,
        ]);
    }

    private function syncPrimaryBarcode(Product $product, ?string $barcode): void
    {
        $barcode = $barcode !== null ? trim($barcode) : null;

        $product->barcodes()
            ->where('variant_id', null)
            ->when($barcode, fn ($query) => $query->where('barcode', '!=', $barcode))
            ->delete();

        if (!$barcode) {
            return;
        }

        ProductBarcode::updateOrCreate(
            [
                'product_id' => $product->id,
                'variant_id' => null,
                'barcode' => $barcode,
            ],
            [
                'barcode_type' => 'custom',
                'is_primary' => true,
            ]
        );
    }
}

        $padding = (int) $request->get('padding', Product::getItemCodeSettings()['padding']);
        
        // Get the next item code
        $nextCode = Product::generateItemCode();
        
        // Get settings
        $settings = Product::getItemCodeSettings();
        
        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'data' => [
                'next_code' => $nextCode,
                'prefix' => $settings['prefix'],
                'padding' => $settings['padding'],
                'example' => $settings['prefix'] . str_pad(1, $settings['padding'], '0', STR_PAD_LEFT),
                'example_next' => $settings['prefix'] . str_pad(2, $settings['padding'], '0', STR_PAD_LEFT),
            ]
        ]);
    }

    public function index(Request $request): AnonymousResourceCollection
    {
        $query = Product::with(['supplier', 'variants.barcodes', 'category', 'brand', 'barcodes']);

        if ($request->has('category')) {
            $query->where('category', $request->category);
        }

        if ($request->has('category_id')) {
            $query->where('category_id', $request->category_id);
        }

        if ($request->has('search')) {
            $search = $request->search;
            $query->where(function ($q) use ($search) {
                $q->where('name', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('sku', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('brand', 'like', "%{$search}%");
            });
        }

        $products = $query->get();

        return ProductResource::collection($products);
    }

    public function search(Request $request): AnonymousResourceCollection
    {
        $query = Product::with(['supplier', 'variants.barcodes', 'category', 'brand', 'barcodes']);

        if ($request->has('barcode')) {
            $barcode = ProductBarcode::where('barcode', $request->barcode)->first();
            if ($barcode) {
                $query->where('id', $barcode->product_id);
                if ($barcode->variant_id) {
                    $query->with(['variants' => function ($q) use ($barcode) {
                        $q->where('id', $barcode->variant_id);
                    }]);
                }
            }
        }

        if ($request->has('q') || $request->has('search')) {
            $search = $request->get('q') ?? $request->get('search');
            $query->where(function ($q) use ($search) {
                $q->where('name', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('sku', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('barcode', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('brand', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhere('item_code', 'like', "%{$search}%")
                  ->orWhereHas('barcodes', function ($q) use ($search) {
                      $q->where('barcode', 'like', "%{$search}%");
                  });
            });
        }

        if ($request->has('category_id')) {
            $query->where('category_id', $request->category_id);
        }

        if ($request->has('brand_id')) {
            $query->where('brand_id', $request->brand_id);
        }

        if ($request->has('low_stock')) {
            $query->whereRaw('current_stock <= min_stock_level');
        }

        $limit = $request->get('limit', 50);
        $products = $query->take($limit)->get();

        return ProductResource::collection($products);
    }

    public function store(StoreProductRequest $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validated();

        // Check for duplicate variants (same size + color combination)
        if (!empty($validated['variants'])) {
            $combinations = [];
            foreach ($validated['variants'] as $index => $variant) {
                $size = $variant['size'] ?? '';
                $color = $variant['color'] ?? '';
                $key = strtolower(trim($size)) . '|' . strtolower(trim($color));
                if (isset($combinations[$key])) {
                    return response()->json([
                        'success' => false,
                        'message' => "Duplicate variant: Size '{$size}' and Color '{$color}' already exists at position " . ($combinations[$key] + 1),
                    ], 422);
                }
                $combinations[$key] = $index;
            }
        }

        // Generate SKU if not provided
        if (empty($validated['sku'])) {
            $validated['sku'] = 'SKU-' . strtoupper(uniqid());
        }

        // Generate item_code if not provided
        if (empty($validated['item_code'])) {
            $settings = Product::getItemCodeSettings();
            $validated['item_code'] = Product::generateItemCode();
            $validated['item_code_prefix'] = $settings['prefix'];
        } else {
            preg_match('/^([A-Za-z]+)/', $validated['item_code'], $matches);
            $validated['item_code_prefix'] = $matches[1] ?? 'item';
        }

        $validated['opening_stock'] = 0;
        $validated['current_stock'] = 0;

        $product = Product::create($validated);
        $this->syncPrimaryBarcode($product, $validated['barcode'] ?? null);

        if (isset($validated['is_variant_product']) && $validated['is_variant_product'] && isset($validated['variants'])) {
            foreach ($validated['variants'] as $variantData) {
                if (empty($variantData['sku'])) {
                    $variantData['sku'] = 'VAR-' . strtoupper(uniqid());
                }
                ProductVariant::create([
                    'product_id' => $product->id,
                    'current_stock' => 0,
                    ...$variantData,
                ]);
            }
        }

        $product->load(['supplier', 'variants.barcodes', 'barcodes']);
        foreach ($product->variants as $variant) {
            $this->syncVariantBarcode($product, $variant, $validated['variants'] ?? []);
        }
        $product->load(['supplier', 'variants.barcodes', 'barcodes']);

        return new ProductResource($product);
    }

    public function show(Product $product)
    {
        if ($product->company_id !== auth()->user()->company_id) {
            abort(403, 'Access denied');
        }
        return new ProductResource($product->load(['supplier', 'variants.barcodes', 'barcodes']));
    }

    public function update(UpdateProductRequest $request, Product $product)
    {
        $validated = $request->validated();

        // Check for duplicate variants (same size + color combination)
        if (!empty($validated['variants'])) {
            $combinations = [];
            foreach ($validated['variants'] as $index => $variant) {
                $key = strtolower(trim($variant['size'] ?? '')) . '|' . strtolower(trim($variant['color'] ?? ''));
                if (isset($combinations[$key])) {
                    return response()->json([
                        'success' => false,
                        'message' => "Duplicate variant: Size '{$variant['size']}' and Color '{$variant['color']}' already exists at position " . ($combinations[$key] + 1),
                    ], 422);
                }
                $combinations[$key] = $index;
            }
        }

        $product->update($validated);
        $this->syncPrimaryBarcode($product, $validated['barcode'] ?? $product->barcode);

        if (isset($validated['variants'])) {
            $existingVariants = $product->variants()->get()->keyBy('id');
            $submittedVariantIds = [];

            foreach ($validated['variants'] as $variantData) {
                $variantId = $variantData['id'] ?? null;
                if (empty($variantData['sku'])) {
                    $variantData['sku'] = 'VAR-' . strtoupper(uniqid());
                }

                unset($variantData['id']);

                if ($variantId && $existingVariants->has($variantId)) {
                    $submittedVariantIds[] = (int) $variantId;
                    $existingVariants[$variantId]->update($variantData);
                    continue;
                }

                $createdVariant = ProductVariant::create([
                    'product_id' => $product->id,
                    'current_stock' => 0,
                    ...$variantData,
                ]);
                $submittedVariantIds[] = $createdVariant->id;
            }

            $variantsToDelete = $existingVariants->reject(fn ($variant) => in_array($variant->id, $submittedVariantIds, true));
            foreach ($variantsToDelete as $variant) {
                if ((int) $variant->current_stock > 0) {
                    return response()->json([
                        'success' => false,
                        'message' => 'Cannot remove variant with existing stock. Adjust stock to zero first.',
                    ], 422);
                }
                $variant->delete();
            }
        }

        return new ProductResource($product->load(['supplier', 'variants', 'barcodes']));
    }

    public function destroy(Product $product)
    {
        $product->delete();

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'message' => 'Product deleted successfully',
        ]);
    }

    public function updateStock(Request $request, Product $product)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'quantity' => 'required|integer',
            'variant_id' => 'nullable|exists:product_variants,id',
            'warehouse_id' => 'nullable|exists:warehouses,id',
            'notes' => 'nullable|string',
        ]);

        $movement = StockMovement::record([
            'product_id' => $product->id,
            'variant_id' => $validated['variant_id'] ?? null,
            'warehouse_id' => $validated['warehouse_id'] ?? null,
            'type' => StockMovement::TYPE_ADJUSTMENT,
            'quantity' => $validated['quantity'],
            'reason' => 'manual',
            'reference_type' => 'product_stock_adjustment',
            'reference_id' => $product->id,
            'notes' => $validated['notes'] ?? 'Product stock updated',
        ]);

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'data' => (new ProductResource($product->fresh()->load(['supplier', 'variants.barcodes', 'barcodes']))),
            'movement_id' => $movement->id,
        ]);
    }

    private function syncVariantBarcode(Product $product, ProductVariant $variant, array $submittedVariants): void
    {
        $matchingInput = collect($submittedVariants)->first(function ($variantInput) use ($variant) {
            if (($variantInput['id'] ?? null) && (string) $variantInput['id'] === (string) $variant->id) {
                return true;
            }

            return ($variantInput['sku'] ?? null) === $variant->sku
                && ($variantInput['size'] ?? '') === $variant->size
                && ($variantInput['color'] ?? '') === $variant->color;
        });

        $barcode = trim((string) ($matchingInput['barcode'] ?? ''));

        $variant->barcodes()->delete();

        if ($barcode === '') {
            return;
        }

        $existingBarcode = ProductBarcode::where('barcode', $barcode)->first();

        if ($existingBarcode && (string) $existingBarcode->variant_id !== (string) $variant->id) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages([
                'barcode' => ["Variant barcode '{$barcode}' is already in use"],
            ]);
        }

        $variant->barcodes()->delete();

        ProductBarcode::create([
            'product_id' => $product->id,
            'variant_id' => $variant->id,
            'barcode' => $barcode,
            'barcode_type' => 'custom',
            'is_primary' => true,
        ]);
    }

    private function syncPrimaryBarcode(Product $product, ?string $barcode): void
    {
        $barcode = $barcode !== null ? trim($barcode) : null;

        $product->barcodes()
            ->where('variant_id', null)
            ->when($barcode, fn ($query) => $query->where('barcode', '!=', $barcode))
            ->delete();

        if (!$barcode) {
            return;
        }

        ProductBarcode::updateOrCreate(
            [
                'product_id' => $product->id,
                'variant_id' => null,
                'barcode' => $barcode,
            ],
            [
                'barcode_type' => 'custom',
                'is_primary' => true,
            ]
        );
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Http\Controllers\Api;

use App\Services\AccountingService;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Http\Resources\Json\AnonymousResourceCollection;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

class PurchaseOrderController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request): AnonymousResourceCollection
    {
        $query = PurchaseOrder::with(['supplier', 'items']);

        if ($request->has('status')) {
            $query->where('status', $request->status);
        }

        if ($request->has('supplier_id')) {
            $query->where('supplier_id', $request->supplier_id);
        }

        $purchaseOrders = $query->orderBy('created_at', 'desc')->get();

    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'po_number' => 'nullable|string|unique:purchase_orders,po_number',
            'supplier_id' => 'required|exists:suppliers,id',
            'date' => 'required|date',
            'due_date' => 'nullable|date|after_or_equal:date',
            'items' => 'required|array|min:1',
            'items.*.product_id' => 'required|exists:products,id',
            'items.*.variant_id' => 'nullable|exists:product_variants,id',
            'items.*.quantity' => 'required|integer|min:1',
            'items.*.unit_cost' => 'required|numeric|min:0',
            'discount_percent' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0|max:100',
            'discount_amount' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0',
            'tax_percent' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0|max:100',
            'supplier_invoice_no' => 'nullable|string|max:50',
            'payment_mode' => 'nullable|in:Cash,UPI,Bank Transfer,Credit,Other',
            'status' => 'sometimes|in:Draft,Sent,Received,Cancelled',
        ]);

        if (!isset($validated['po_number'])) {
            $validated['po_number'] = 'PO-' . strtoupper(Str::random(8));
        }

        $subTotal = 0;
        foreach ($validated['items'] as $item) {
            $subTotal += $item['quantity'] * $item['unit_cost'];
        }
        
        $discountPercent = $validated['discount_percent'] ?? 0;
        $discountAmount = $validated['discount_amount'] ?? ($subTotal * $discountPercent / 100);
        $taxableAmount = $subTotal - $discountAmount;
        $taxPercent = $validated['tax_percent'] ?? 0;
        $taxAmount = $taxableAmount * $taxPercent / 100;
        $totalAmount = $taxableAmount + $taxAmount;

        $validated['sub_total'] = $subTotal;
        $validated['discount_percent'] = $discountPercent;
        $validated['discount_amount'] = $discountAmount;
        $validated['tax_percent'] = $taxPercent;
        $validated['tax_amount'] = $taxAmount;
        $validated['total_amount'] = $totalAmount;
        $validated['amount_paid'] = 0;
        $validated['balance_due'] = $totalAmount;
        $validated['payment_status'] = 'Pending';

        $purchaseOrder = PurchaseOrder::create($validated);

                'purchase_order_id' => $purchaseOrder->id,
                'company_id' => $purchaseOrder->company_id,
                ...$itemData,
            ]);
        }

        // If status is Received, update stock immediately
        if (($validated['status'] ?? 'Draft') === 'Received') {
            $this->updateStockFromPO($purchaseOrder);
            // Post accounting transactions
            AccountingService::postPurchaseOrderReceived($purchaseOrder);
        }

        return new PurchaseOrderResource($purchaseOrder->load(['supplier', 'items']));
