    public function show(PurchaseOrder $purchaseOrder)
    {
        return new PurchaseOrderResource($purchaseOrder->load(['supplier', 'items']));
    }

    public function update(Request $request, PurchaseOrder $purchaseOrder)
    {
        // Check if PO can be edited based on ERP rules
        if (!$purchaseOrder->canBeEdited()) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'This purchase order cannot be edited because it is fully received and locked.',
            ], 422);
        }

        $validated = $request->validate([
            'supplier_id' => 'sometimes|exists:suppliers,id',
            'date' => 'sometimes|date',
            'status' => 'sometimes|in:Draft,Sent,Received,Cancelled',
            'items' => 'sometimes|array',
            'items.*.product_id' => 'required|exists:products,id',
            'items.*.variant_id' => 'nullable|exists:product_variants,id',
            'items.*.quantity' => 'required|integer|min:1',
            'items.*.unit_cost' => 'required|numeric|min:0',
        ]);

        // ERP RULE 3: Received quantity cannot be reduced by editing PO
        if (isset($validated['items'])) {
            $newTotalQuantity = 0;
            foreach ($validated['items'] as $itemData) {
                $newTotalQuantity += $itemData['quantity'];
            }

            if ($newTotalQuantity < $purchaseOrder->received_quantity) {
                return response()->json([
                    'success' => false,
                    'message' => "Cannot reduce order quantity below received quantity. Ordered: {$newTotalQuantity}, Already received: {$purchaseOrder->received_quantity}",
                ], 422);
            }

            // Update items
            $purchaseOrder->items()->delete();
            $totalAmount = 0;
            foreach ($validated['items'] as $itemData) {
                PurchaseOrderItem::create([
                    'purchase_order_id' => $purchaseOrder->id,
                    ...$itemData,
                ]);
                $totalAmount += $itemData['quantity'] * $itemData['unit_cost'];
            }
            $validated['total_amount'] = $totalAmount;
        }

        $oldStatus = $purchaseOrder->status;
        $purchaseOrder->update($validated);

        // Update receipt status based on new quantities
        $purchaseOrder->updateReceiptStatus();

        // Note: Stock changes only through GRN, not PO status changes
        // Removed automatic stock update on status change

        return new PurchaseOrderResource($purchaseOrder->load(['supplier', 'items']));
    }

    public function receive(PurchaseOrder $purchaseOrder)
    {
        if ($purchaseOrder->status === 'Received') {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Purchase order already received',
            ], 400);
        }

        $purchaseOrder->status = 'Received';
        $purchaseOrder->save();

        $this->updateStockFromPO($purchaseOrder);

        // Post accounting transactions
        AccountingService::postPurchaseOrderReceived($purchaseOrder);

        return new PurchaseOrderResource($purchaseOrder->load(['supplier', 'items']));
    }

    public function cancel(PurchaseOrder $purchaseOrder)
    {
        if ($purchaseOrder->status === 'Cancelled') {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Purchase order already cancelled',
            ], 400);
        }

        $purchaseOrder->status = 'Cancelled';
        $purchaseOrder->save();

        return new PurchaseOrderResource($purchaseOrder->load(['supplier', 'items']));
    }

    public function recordPayment(Request $request, PurchaseOrder $purchaseOrder)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'amount' => 'required|numeric|min:0.01',
            'payment_mode' => 'required|in:Cash,UPI,Bank Transfer,Credit,Other',
            'use_supplier_credit' => 'nullable|boolean',
            'notes' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
        ]);

        $supplier = $purchaseOrder->supplier;
        $totalAmount = $purchaseOrder->total_amount;
        $currentPaid = (float) $purchaseOrder->amount_paid;
        $currentBalance = (float) $purchaseOrder->balance_due;
        
        $cashAmount = (float) $validated['amount'];
        $useCredit = $validated['use_supplier_credit'] ?? false;
        $creditUsed = 0;
        $overpaymentCredit = 0;

        $newBalance = $currentBalance - $cashAmount;

        if ($newBalance < 0) {
            $overpaymentCredit = abs($newBalance);
            $newBalance = 0;
        }

        $newAmountPaid = $totalAmount - $newBalance;
        $newBalanceDue = $newBalance;

        $paymentStatus = 'Pending';
        if ($newBalanceDue <= 0) {
            $paymentStatus = 'Paid';
        } elseif ($newAmountPaid > 0) {
            $paymentStatus = 'Partially Paid';
        }

        if ($overpaymentCredit > 0 && $supplier) {
            SupplierCredit::addCredit($supplier, $overpaymentCredit, "Excess payment on PO {$purchaseOrder->po_number} credited back", $purchaseOrder);
        }

        $purchaseOrder->update([
            'amount_paid' => $newAmountPaid,
            'balance_due' => $newBalanceDue,
            'payment_status' => $paymentStatus,
            'payment_mode' => $validated['payment_mode'],
        ]);

        AccountingService::postPurchasePayment($purchaseOrder, $cashAmount, $validated['payment_mode']);

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'message' => 'Payment recorded successfully',
            'data' => [
                'purchase_order' => new PurchaseOrderResource($purchaseOrder->load(['supplier', 'items'])),
                'payment' => [
                    'cash_amount' => $cashAmount,
                    'credit_used' => $creditUsed,
                    'overpayment_credited' => $overpaymentCredit,
                    'payment_status' => $paymentStatus,
                    'amount_paid' => $newAmountPaid,
                    'balance_due' => $newBalanceDue,
                ]
            ]
        ]);
    }

    public function supplierOutstanding()
    {
        $suppliers = Supplier::with(['purchaseOrders' => function($q) {
            $q->whereNotIn('status', ['Cancelled']);
        }])->get();

        $result = [];
        foreach ($suppliers as $supplier) {
            $totalAmount = $supplier->purchaseOrders->sum('total_amount');
            $totalPaid = $supplier->purchaseOrders->sum('amount_paid');
            $totalBalanceDue = $supplier->purchaseOrders->whereIn('payment_status', ['Pending', 'Partially Paid'])->sum('balance_due');
            
            $totalReturns = PurchaseReturn::where('supplier_id', $supplier->id)
                ->where('status', 'approved')
                ->sum('grand_total');
            
            $creditAdded = SupplierCredit::where('supplier_id', $supplier->id)
                ->whereIn('type', ['credit', 'return'])
                ->sum('amount');
            $creditUsed = SupplierCredit::where('supplier_id', $supplier->id)
                ->whereIn('type', ['used', 'refund'])
                ->sum('amount');
            $availableCredit = $supplier->available_credit ?? ($creditAdded - $creditUsed);
            
            $adjustedOutstanding = $totalBalanceDue - $availableCredit;
            
            if ($totalBalanceDue > 0 || $availableCredit > 0) {
                $result[] = [
                    'supplier_id' => $supplier->id,
                    'supplier' => $supplier,
                    'po_count' => $supplier->purchaseOrders->count(),
                    'total_amount' => $totalAmount,
                    'total_paid' => $totalPaid,
                    'total_returns' => $totalReturns,
                    'total_balance_due' => $totalBalanceDue,
                    'available_credit' => $availableCredit,
                    'adjusted_outstanding' => max(0, $adjustedOutstanding),
                ];
            }
        }

        usort($result, fn($a, $b) => $b['adjusted_outstanding'] <=> $a['adjusted_outstanding']);

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'data' => $result
        ]);
    }

    public function destroy(PurchaseOrder $purchaseOrder)
    {
        // ERP RULE: PO can be deleted only if no stock has been received
        if (!$purchaseOrder->canBeDeleted()) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => "Cannot delete purchase order because {$purchaseOrder->received_quantity} units have already been received. Please cancel the receipts first.",
            ], 422);
        }

        // Delete purchase order items first (due to foreign key constraints)
        $purchaseOrder->items()->delete();
        
        // Delete the purchase order
        $purchaseOrder->delete();

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'message' => 'Purchase order deleted successfully',
        ]);
    }

    private function updateStockFromPO(PurchaseOrder $purchaseOrder)

                } else {

                    $product->save();
                    
                    $warehouseStock = WarehouseStock::where('product_id', $product->id)

                    if ($warehouseStock) {

<?php

    {

            $query->where('status', $request->status);
        }

        if ($request->has('supplier_id')) {
            $query->where('supplier_id', $request->supplier_id);
        }

        $purchaseOrders = $query->orderBy('created_at', 'desc')->get();

        return PurchaseOrderResource::collection($purchaseOrders);
    }

    public function store(Request $request)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'po_number' => 'nullable|string|unique:purchase_orders,po_number',
            'supplier_id' => 'required|exists:suppliers,id',
            'date' => 'required|date',
            'due_date' => 'nullable|date|after_or_equal:date',
            'items' => 'required|array|min:1',
            'items.*.product_id' => 'required|exists:products,id',
            'items.*.variant_id' => 'nullable|exists:product_variants,id',
            'items.*.quantity' => 'required|integer|min:1',
            'items.*.unit_cost' => 'required|numeric|min:0',
            'discount_percent' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0|max:100',
            'discount_amount' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0',
            'tax_percent' => 'nullable|numeric|min:0|max:100',
            'supplier_invoice_no' => 'nullable|string|max:50',
            'payment_mode' => 'nullable|in:Cash,UPI,Bank Transfer,Credit,Other',
            'status' => 'sometimes|in:Draft,Sent,Received,Cancelled',
        ]);

        if (!isset($validated['po_number'])) {
            $validated['po_number'] = 'PO-' . strtoupper(Str::random(8));
        }

        $subTotal = 0;
        foreach ($validated['items'] as $item) {
            $subTotal += $item['quantity'] * $item['unit_cost'];
        }
        
        $discountPercent = $validated['discount_percent'] ?? 0;
        $discountAmount = $validated['discount_amount'] ?? ($subTotal * $discountPercent / 100);
        $taxableAmount = $subTotal - $discountAmount;
        $taxPercent = $validated['tax_percent'] ?? 0;
        $taxAmount = $taxableAmount * $taxPercent / 100;
        $totalAmount = $taxableAmount + $taxAmount;

        $validated['sub_total'] = $subTotal;
        $validated['discount_percent'] = $discountPercent;
        $validated['discount_amount'] = $discountAmount;
        $validated['tax_percent'] = $taxPercent;
        $validated['tax_amount'] = $taxAmount;
        $validated['total_amount'] = $totalAmount;
        $validated['amount_paid'] = 0;
        $validated['balance_due'] = $totalAmount;
        $validated['payment_status'] = 'Pending';

        $purchaseOrder = PurchaseOrder::create($validated);

        foreach ($validated['items'] as $itemData) {
            PurchaseOrderItem::create([
                'purchase_order_id' => $purchaseOrder->id,
                'company_id' => $purchaseOrder->company_id,
                ...$itemData,
            ]);
        }

        // If status is Received, update stock immediately
        if (($validated['status'] ?? 'Draft') === 'Received') {
            $this->updateStockFromPO($purchaseOrder);
            // Post accounting transactions
            AccountingService::postPurchaseOrderReceived($purchaseOrder);
        }

        return new PurchaseOrderResource($purchaseOrder->load(['supplier', 'items']));

    public function show(PurchaseOrder $purchaseOrder)
    {
        if ($purchaseOrder->company_id !== auth()->user()->company_id) {
            abort(403, 'Access denied');
        }
        return new PurchaseOrderResource($purchaseOrder->load(['supplier', 'items']));
    }

    public function update(Request $request, PurchaseOrder $purchaseOrder)
    {
        // Check if PO can be edited based on ERP rules
        if (!$purchaseOrder->canBeEdited()) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'This purchase order cannot be edited because it is fully received and locked.',
            ], 422);
        }

        $validated = $request->validate([
            'supplier_id' => 'sometimes|exists:suppliers,id',
            'date' => 'sometimes|date',
            'status' => 'sometimes|in:Draft,Sent,Received,Cancelled',
            'items' => 'sometimes|array',
            'items.*.product_id' => 'required|exists:products,id',
            'items.*.variant_id' => 'nullable|exists:product_variants,id',
            'items.*.quantity' => 'required|integer|min:1',
            'items.*.unit_cost' => 'required|numeric|min:0',
        ]);

        // ERP RULE 3: Received quantity cannot be reduced by editing PO
        if (isset($validated['items'])) {
            $newTotalQuantity = 0;
            foreach ($validated['items'] as $itemData) {
                $newTotalQuantity += $itemData['quantity'];
            }

            if ($newTotalQuantity < $purchaseOrder->received_quantity) {
                return response()->json([
                    'success' => false,
                    'message' => "Cannot reduce order quantity below received quantity. Ordered: {$newTotalQuantity}, Already received: {$purchaseOrder->received_quantity}",
                ], 422);
            }

            // Update items
            $purchaseOrder->items()->delete();
            $totalAmount = 0;
            foreach ($validated['items'] as $itemData) {
                PurchaseOrderItem::create([
                    'purchase_order_id' => $purchaseOrder->id,
                    ...$itemData,
                ]);
                $totalAmount += $itemData['quantity'] * $itemData['unit_cost'];
            }
            $validated['total_amount'] = $totalAmount;
        }

        $oldStatus = $purchaseOrder->status;
        $purchaseOrder->update($validated);

        // Update receipt status based on new quantities
        $purchaseOrder->updateReceiptStatus();

        // Note: Stock changes only through GRN, not PO status changes
        // Removed automatic stock update on status change

        return new PurchaseOrderResource($purchaseOrder->load(['supplier', 'items']));
    }

    public function receive(PurchaseOrder $purchaseOrder)
    {
        if ($purchaseOrder->status === 'Received') {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Purchase order already received',
            ], 400);
        }

        $purchaseOrder->status = 'Received';
        $purchaseOrder->save();

        $this->updateStockFromPO($purchaseOrder);

        // Post accounting transactions
        AccountingService::postPurchaseOrderReceived($purchaseOrder);

        return new PurchaseOrderResource($purchaseOrder->load(['supplier', 'items']));
    }

    public function cancel(PurchaseOrder $purchaseOrder)
    {
        if ($purchaseOrder->status === 'Cancelled') {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Purchase order already cancelled',
            ], 400);
        }

        $purchaseOrder->status = 'Cancelled';
        $purchaseOrder->save();

        return new PurchaseOrderResource($purchaseOrder->load(['supplier', 'items']));
    }

    public function recordPayment(Request $request, PurchaseOrder $purchaseOrder)
    {
        $validated = $request->validate([
            'amount' => 'required|numeric|min:0.01',
            'payment_mode' => 'required|in:Cash,UPI,Bank Transfer,Credit,Other',
            'use_supplier_credit' => 'nullable|boolean',
            'notes' => 'nullable|string|max:255',
        ]);

        $supplier = $purchaseOrder->supplier;
        $totalAmount = $purchaseOrder->total_amount;
        $currentPaid = (float) $purchaseOrder->amount_paid;
        $currentBalance = (float) $purchaseOrder->balance_due;
        
        $cashAmount = (float) $validated['amount'];
        $useCredit = $validated['use_supplier_credit'] ?? false;
        $creditUsed = 0;
        $overpaymentCredit = 0;

        $newBalance = $currentBalance - $cashAmount;

        if ($newBalance < 0) {
            $overpaymentCredit = abs($newBalance);
            $newBalance = 0;
        }

        $newAmountPaid = $totalAmount - $newBalance;
        $newBalanceDue = $newBalance;

        $paymentStatus = 'Pending';
        if ($newBalanceDue <= 0) {
            $paymentStatus = 'Paid';
        } elseif ($newAmountPaid > 0) {
            $paymentStatus = 'Partially Paid';
        }

        if ($overpaymentCredit > 0 && $supplier) {
            SupplierCredit::addCredit($supplier, $overpaymentCredit, "Excess payment on PO {$purchaseOrder->po_number} credited back", $purchaseOrder);
        }

        $purchaseOrder->update([
            'amount_paid' => $newAmountPaid,
            'balance_due' => $newBalanceDue,
            'payment_status' => $paymentStatus,
            'payment_mode' => $validated['payment_mode'],
        ]);

        AccountingService::postPurchasePayment($purchaseOrder, $cashAmount, $validated['payment_mode']);

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'message' => 'Payment recorded successfully',
            'data' => [
                'purchase_order' => new PurchaseOrderResource($purchaseOrder->load(['supplier', 'items'])),
                'payment' => [
                    'cash_amount' => $cashAmount,
                    'credit_used' => $creditUsed,
                    'overpayment_credited' => $overpaymentCredit,
                    'payment_status' => $paymentStatus,
                    'amount_paid' => $newAmountPaid,
                    'balance_due' => $newBalanceDue,
                ]
            ]
        ]);
    }

    public function supplierOutstanding()
    {
        $suppliers = Supplier::with(['purchaseOrders' => function($q) {
            $q->whereNotIn('status', ['Cancelled']);
        }])->get();

        $result = [];
        foreach ($suppliers as $supplier) {
            $totalAmount = $supplier->purchaseOrders->sum('total_amount');
            $totalPaid = $supplier->purchaseOrders->sum('amount_paid');
            $totalBalanceDue = $supplier->purchaseOrders->whereIn('payment_status', ['Pending', 'Partially Paid'])->sum('balance_due');
            
            $totalReturns = PurchaseReturn::where('supplier_id', $supplier->id)
                ->where('status', 'approved')
                ->sum('grand_total');
            
            $creditAdded = SupplierCredit::where('supplier_id', $supplier->id)
                ->whereIn('type', ['credit', 'return'])
                ->sum('amount');
            $creditUsed = SupplierCredit::where('supplier_id', $supplier->id)
                ->whereIn('type', ['used', 'refund'])
                ->sum('amount');
            $availableCredit = $supplier->available_credit ?? ($creditAdded - $creditUsed);
            
            $adjustedOutstanding = $totalBalanceDue - $availableCredit;
            
            if ($totalBalanceDue > 0 || $availableCredit > 0) {
                $result[] = [
                    'supplier_id' => $supplier->id,
                    'supplier' => $supplier,
                    'po_count' => $supplier->purchaseOrders->count(),
                    'total_amount' => $totalAmount,
                    'total_paid' => $totalPaid,
                    'total_returns' => $totalReturns,
                    'total_balance_due' => $totalBalanceDue,
                    'available_credit' => $availableCredit,
                    'adjusted_outstanding' => max(0, $adjustedOutstanding),
                ];
            }
        }

        usort($result, fn($a, $b) => $b['adjusted_outstanding'] <=> $a['adjusted_outstanding']);

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'data' => $result
        ]);
    }

    public function destroy(PurchaseOrder $purchaseOrder)
    {
        // ERP RULE: PO can be deleted only if no stock has been received
        if (!$purchaseOrder->canBeDeleted()) {
            return response()->json([
                'success' => false,
                'message' => "Cannot delete purchase order because {$purchaseOrder->received_quantity} units have already been received. Please cancel the receipts first.",
            ], 422);
        }

        // Delete purchase order items first (due to foreign key constraints)
        $purchaseOrder->items()->delete();
        
        // Delete the purchase order
        $purchaseOrder->delete();

        return response()->json([
            'success' => true,
            'message' => 'Purchase order deleted successfully',
        ]);
    }

    private function updateStockFromPO(PurchaseOrder $purchaseOrder)
    {
        $costingEngine = app(\App\Services\CostingEngine::class);
        
        foreach ($purchaseOrder->items as $item) {
            $product = Product::find($item->product_id);
            $newQty = (float) $item->quantity;
            $newCost = (float) $item->unit_cost;
            $variantId = $item->variant_id;
            
            if ($product) {
                if ($variantId) {
                    $variant = ProductVariant::find($variantId);
                    if ($variant) {
                        $variant->current_stock += $newQty;

                        $variant->save();
                        
                        $warehouseStock = WarehouseStock::where('product_id', $product->id)
                            ->where('variant_id', $variantId)
                            ->first();
                        
                        if ($warehouseStock) {
                            $currentQty = (float) $warehouseStock->quantity;
                            $currentCost = (float) $warehouseStock->avg_cost;
                            $newAvgCost = $costingEngine->calculateAverageCost($product, $newQty, $newCost);
                            $warehouseStock->update([
                                'quantity' => $currentQty + $newQty,

                            ]);
                        } else {

                                'company_id' => $purchaseOrder->company_id,

                        $product->current_stock = $product->variants->sum('current_stock');

                    $product->current_stock += $newQty;

                    $warehouseStock = WarehouseStock::where('product_id', $product->id)
                        ->whereNull('variant_id')
                        ->first();
                    
                    if ($warehouseStock) {
                        $currentQty = (float) $warehouseStock->quantity;
                        $currentCost = (float) $warehouseStock->avg_cost;
                        $newAvgCost = $costingEngine->calculateAverageCost($product, $newQty, $newCost);
                        $warehouseStock->update([

class PurchaseReceiptController extends Controller
{
    public function index(Request $request): AnonymousResourceCollection
    {
        $query = PurchaseReceipt::with(['supplier', 'items.product', 'purchaseOrder']);

        if ($request->has('status')) {
            $query->where('status', $request->status);
        }

        if ($request->has('supplier_id')) {
            $query->where('supplier_id', $request->supplier_id);
        }

        if ($request->has('purchase_order_id')) {
            $query->where('purchase_order_id', $request->purchase_order_id);
        }

        $receipts = $query->orderBy('created_at', 'desc')->get();

        return PurchaseReceiptResource::collection($receipts);
    }

    public function show(PurchaseReceipt $purchaseReceipt)
    {
        if ($purchaseReceipt->company_id !== auth()->user()->company_id) {
            abort(403, 'Access denied');
        }
        return new PurchaseReceiptResource($purchaseReceipt->load(['supplier', 'items.product.baseUnit', 'items.variant', 'purchaseOrder']));
    }

    public function store(Request $request)
    {

            'items' => 'required|array|min:1',
            'items.*.product_id' => 'required|exists:products,id',

            'notes' => 'nullable|string',
        ]);

        $purchaseOrder = PurchaseOrder::find($validated['purchase_order_id']);

        $latestReceipt = PurchaseReceipt::orderBy('id', 'desc')->first();
        $nextNumber = $latestReceipt ? $latestReceipt->id + 1 : 1;
